Core units: Lead and Manage Effective Workplace Relationships, Lead and Manage Team Effectiveness, Communicate Effectively as a Workplace Leader, Establish Networks, Develop and Use Emotional Intelligence
Electives: Manage Operational Plans, Manage Recruitment and Onboarding, Manage Workplace Information Systems
Assessment: workplace scenarios, leadership portfolio, team-based projects
Pathway: credit toward second-year entry into a partner university business or management degree
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0)

name: Diploma of Marketing and Communication
description:
The diploma covers both traditional marketing fundamentals (market research, campaign development, brand positioning) and the digital and social media skills that most entry-level marketing roles now expect on day one. The balance is deliberate, since a purely traditional marketing curriculum would leave graduates behind on the tools most Australian marketing teams actually use.

Assessment is built around producing a genuine campaign or communications plan, usually for a real or realistic small business brief, so the portfolio students leave with has actual work samples in it rather than just a transcript. Greenwich's Sydney CBD location also gives students reasonably direct access to the agency and media scene for guest input and, less formally, networking.

Graduates use the diploma either as a direct entry point into junior marketing, communications or social media coordinator roles, or as credit toward a partner university marketing or communications degree.
curriculum:
Core units: Develop Marketing Communication Plans, Undertake Marketing Activities, Interpret Market Trends and Developments, Develop Digital and Social Media Strategies, Coordinate Marketing Activities
Electives: Manage Marketing Campaigns, Analyse Consumer Behaviour, Write Persuasive Copy
Capstone: full campaign or communications plan produced for a real or realistic business brief
Pathway: credit toward partner university marketing or communications degree entry
admission_requirements: Completion of Year 12 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0)

name: Diploma of Project Management
description:
This diploma teaches project management as a set of applied tools rather than a body of theory. Students work through a project life cycle end to end (scope, schedule, budget, risk, stakeholder communication, close-out) using templates and documentation styles drawn from real workplace project files rather than textbook case studies.

It's a shorter, more focused qualification than Greenwich's general business diploma, and it attracts a slightly different student: people who already have a rough sense of which industry they want to work in (construction, IT, events, government) and want the credential and the practical toolkit specifically, rather than a broad business grounding. The compact structure also makes it one of the faster diploma options on Greenwich's timetable.

name: Bachelor of Aviation

Study one of Australia's largest and most highly recognised aviation degrees and launch your career in the exciting global aviation industry. The Bachelor of Aviation is an accelerated full-time two-year degree designed to get you career-ready sooner. You'll build a strong foundation in the science and theory of flying while gaining the practical skills needed for a wide range of operational and managerial roles in aviation. The Bachelor of Aviation together with fully self-funded flight training with an external provider will allow graduates to work in the aviation industry as a commercial pilot. Study core courses like aerodynamics, meteorology, aircraft systems, flight operations and navigation, safety management systems and the human factors (how people influence safety) in aviation, preparing you for the next step into professional flight training or other operational and managerial pathways. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Aviation Accelerated two-year program to fast-track your aviation degree Access advanced on-campus flight simulators for realistic training Learn from industry experts and aviation researchers with global experience Be prepared for pilot training or other operational or managerial roles in aviation. Build skills and connections for your aviation career You may choose to progress into flight school training with providers certified by the Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA), where you can accumulate flight hours and earn your Commercial Pilot Licence. We recommend flight training is undertaken after completing your degree.

description: The Bachelor of Aviation Management at Griffith University prepares students for leadership and management roles across airports, airlines and aviation organisations worldwide. description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Biomedical Science degree. Unlock discoveries shaping the future of health. Biomedical science helps society through applying new scientific knowledge to medicine and healthcare. In this degree, you'll develop skills and knowledge in clinical and biological sciences, and how to harness them to improve the diagnosis and treatment of disease. Students who enrol in this degree at Brisbane South (Nathan) will have a science-focused curriculum. If you wish to study at the Gold Coast, you should apply for the Bachelor of Biomedical Science (1094) and will have a health-focused curriculum. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Biomedical Science Be introduced to the fields that underpin biomedical science from your first year. Explore more advanced aspects in your second and third year, including genetics, biochemistry, cell biology, anatomy, physiology, immunology, microbiology, infectious disease, pharmacology and neuroscience. Learn through lab-based training in specialised facilities, with simulated teaching environments and virtual reality technology. With close links to leading clinics and labs, you'll gain first-hand experience with a broad range of placement opportunities. Learn through multidisciplinary teamwork Study alongside students from the full range of clinical health areas, giving you the skills and knowledge you need to thrive in the kind of teams you may work in after you graduate.

description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Biomolecular Science (Honours) degree. Today's discoveries in the biomolecular sciences lead to tomorrow's applications in fields ranging from medicine and healthcare to food, agriculture, environmental protection and the biotechnology industries. Biomolecular science is the most rapidly developing area in science at the crossroads of the biological, chemical, physical and computational sciences that are driving the current extraordinary advances across biotechnology and medicine. It encompasses chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, the new genetics, genetic engineering, genomics and proteomics, structural and systems biology and bioinformatics. The program gives you a unique opportunity to be immersed in specialised research during your undergraduate studies, with the flexibility to undertake a fourth year level research track, or to exit after successful completion of third year level with a Bachelor of Biomolecular Science.

description: Train to become an Accredited Exercise Physiologist (AEP) and step into a high-demand career. You'll gain in-depth knowledge of the human body and how exercise impacts health. As an AEP, you'll design and deliver safe, effective exercise programs for clients with chronic conditions, injuries or disabilities, providing guidance, support and lifestyle advice to help them improve their health and wellbeing. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Clinical Exercise Physiology Griffith has a five-star rating for overall experience and teaching quality in the field of sports and leisure*. Combine classroom learning with clinical training and practical placements. Study alongside students and staff from diverse clinical backgrounds, preparing you to collaborate as a member of a multidisciplinary team. Learn using the latest technology, including specialised simulations. Study alongside world-leading researchers in their fields. Expand your skills and network through practical placements Grow your professional network through placements and clinical training at our on-campus clinics, or with leading community-based service providers. Build your skills and experience working with individuals with a diverse range of chronic conditions and disabilities. Learn in highly regarded facilities Our modern labs provide an unrivalled learning experience. This unique environment includes a $150 million Griffith Health Centre at the Gold Coast. At Australia's #1 university for elite athletes**, you'll have access to purpose-built, professional-grade facilities, including an Olympic swimming pool, athletics track and high-tech labs. *Good Universities Guide 2025 **Griffith had more athletes at the Paris Olympics than any other Australian University.

You'll graduate from this degree ready to work with, design and adapt to the intelligent technologies shaping the future. Learn the core principles of computing, from software development to information systems, across multiple platforms and applications. Build a strong foundation in programming, algorithms, software engineering and computer systems, while exploring specialised areas such as machine learning, robotics, big data mining, analytics and visualisation, distributed computing and intelligent systems. name: Bachelor of Counselling
description: Meet the demand for caring professionals who support the wellbeing of individuals, families, and communities. With Griffith's Bachelor of Counselling, you'll gain the theoretical knowledge and practical skills to register and practice as a professional counsellor. You'll graduate ready to work across a broad range of organisations, helping people address personal, work and relationship challenges. You'll learn through collaborative teaching environments and master current healthcare and mental health practice standards to help create a healthier future for all. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Counselling Build a solid foundation in counselling, learning both the theory and practical skills you'll need to support people in different settings, from clinics to community programs. Get hands-on experience through placements to boost your skills and confidence. Graduate ready for registration with the Australian Register of Counsellors and Psychotherapists (ARCAP), with opportunities to join other professional organisations and set your path toward becoming an accredited counsellor. Learn alongside students from other health disciplines, preparing for work in collaborative, interprofessional environments. Learn from practising experts who are part of major Australian research projects at the world-renowned Griffith Centre for Mental Health. Professional placements Apply your skills through clinical placements at our on-campus clinics or partner healthcare providers. This degree includes an internship and culminates in two counselling placements, allowing you to work directly with clients in professional counselling organisations. Build the skills to guide and support others Counselling is about guiding and empowering people to achieve their goals.

name: Bachelor of Criminology and Criminal Justice
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Criminology and Criminal Justice degree. Study with Queensland's top-ranked university for criminology* and use your degree as a launch pad to join the fight for justice, contribute to a safer community and a better criminal justice system. Learn from experts and industry leaders who bring their hands-on experience to your study. Our strong international research reputation means you will be taught by academics who are recognised worldwide in their various fields. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Criminology and Criminal Justice Explore the causes of crime, how laws are made and broken, the impacts on victims, offenders and the justice system's response. Analyse crime with a focus on social justice, including the roles of police, courts and corrections. Draw on knowledge and insights from many fields of study including psychology, law, sociology, politics and social work. Study topics like criminal law, homicide, First Nations justice, fraud and cybercrime, and domestic and family violence. Learn how crime happens, ways it can be reduced and evidence-based strategies to keep communities safe. You'll also explore how research is used to measure impact and improve understanding. Develop practical skills in data analysis and visualisation to understand and interpret patterns and clearly present information

name: Bachelor of Cyber Security
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Cyber Security degree. The Brisbane South (Nathan) offering of this program is scheduled to be delivered at the Treasury Building at our Brisbane City campus in 2027. If scheduled opening is delayed, courses may be delivered all or in part at our other Brisbane locations. Queensland's #1 university for AI research. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2025) Step into one of Australia's fastest-growing and most in-demand fields with a Bachelor of Cyber Security. Master the tools and technologies that protect critical data, systems and networks across business, government and everyday life. You'll develop a deep understanding of how cyber-attacks occur and how to stop them, through practical training, real-world simulations and industry experience. As AI becomes increasingly embedded in organisations and digital systems, you'll learn how to identify vulnerabilities, protect AI-enabled technologies and defend against emerging AI-driven threats. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Cyber Security Train in specialised facilities like our Cyber Range, a dedicated simulated environment where you'll defend against live cyber incidents and test your skills in realistic scenarios. Learn from industry experts who bring cyber security experience from sectors including government, finance and national defence. Build a strong foundation in IT fundamentals including programming, networking, data management and systems administration, before diving into advanced cyber security topics. Explore how AI systems work, where they can fail and how cyber security professionals can protect against malicious use of AI technologies.

name: Bachelor of Dental Hygiene
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Dental Hygiene degree. Take your first steps towards becoming a registered dental hygienist. With the Bachelor of Dental Hygiene you'll gain the ability to provide patient-centred oral health care, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment, management and education for the management and prevention of oral diseases in patients of all ages. You'll have the opportunity to undertake practical training in specialty clinics and learn from dental specialists in the fields of: periodontology radiology and radiography orthodontics oral pathology pharmacology special needs public health and health promotion. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Dental Hygiene Learn to assess, diagnose, treat, manage, and educate patients in the prevention of oral diseases. Hands-on training in specialty clinics in the disciplines periodontology, implantology and orthodontics Learn skills in public health and health promotion to provide appropriate preventive oral health education to individuals and communities. Clinical training in a collaborative environment Build practical skills in our modern dental clinic and simulation lab, learning the latest techniques and technologies alongside dentistry students. You'll also work with dentists, dental technicians, dental prosthetists and specialists, developing the communication and teamwork skills essential for effective patient care and clinical practice.

Our studio-first program, registered by the Design Institute of Australia (DIA), cultivates high levels of design expertise. You'll learn in innovative, creative studio spaces at the Queensland College of Art and Design and leverage unique opportunities in our highly regarded facilities, including galleries and purpose-built design studios. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Design Work with experts from the design industry to tackle real challenges and create innovative solutions. Advance your critical and strategic thinking and learn to present your ideas clearly and powerfully. Learn from award-winning design professionals and educators, with experience across a wide range of design practices. name: Bachelor of Early Childhood and Primary Education
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Early Childhood and Primary Education degree. This degree is pending dual accreditation with the Queensland College of Teachers (QCT) and the Australian Children's Education & Care Quality Authority (ACECQA). Everyone has that one teacher that always believed in them. Be that teacher for your students and help create a brighter future for the next generation. This degree is designed to meet the urgent need for high-quality teachers in early childhood centres and primary schools and other educational settings. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Early Childhood and Primary Education A shared foundation year, between the Bachelor of Early Childhood and Primary Education, Bachelor of Primary Education and Bachelor of Secondary Education, to develop key insights into major trends and themes in education. This shared foundation year allows for a seamless transition between degrees, giving you time to decide which age group you feel most comfortable teaching. Benefit from our strong relationships with schools and industry partners. During your studies, you'll undertake 110 days of supervised professional experience with a dedicated placement officer to assist in organising your placement. Choose to specialise in a range of in-demand areas, including early childhood, STEM and digital technologies, to boost your teaching career early. Learn at your own pace, with flexible options including online learning you may be able to fast-track your studies. Once the degree is accredited, accredited, eligible students can apply for Queensland teacher registration as soon as they graduate.

You'll also have the chance to join active clubs and societies that connect you with like-minded peers and expand your professional community. During your study, you'll engage in extensive industry placements, collaborative projects and hands-on research opportunities. With a wide choice of majors, strong professional networks and intentionally smaller cohorts, you'll graduate with the confidence, skills and connections to step straight into your career. name: Bachelor of Environmental Science
description: Queensland's #1 university for marine and ocean engineering. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2025) Study environmental science at Griffith and gain the scientific knowledge, practical experience and confidence to tackle some of the most pressing challenges of our time. This degree blends strong scientific foundations with hands-on learning, preparing you for a career where you can make a genuine impact on the environment and society. Whether your goal is to better understand natural systems or actively protect them, you'll graduate with skills, scientific rigour and informed decision-making expertise in environmental management. At Griffith, you'll learn in a living lab as our campuses are surrounded by bushland, waterways and marine ecosystems, giving you direct exposure to real environmental systems with sustainability and environmental responsibility embedded throughout your studies. You'll explore environmental challenges from social, physical and biological perspectives, supported by an interdisciplinary curriculum spanning ecology, chemistry, data science, management and policy. Learning takes place well beyond the classroom, with extensive fieldwork, lab activities and immersive field trips in unique natural environments. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Environmental Science With more than 50 years' experience training environmental scientists, Griffith understands industry and government needs, ensuring you graduate career-ready. Gain extensive hands-on experience through labs, ecological surveys, data modelling, applied research, field trips and professional placements with government, NGOs and industry partners. Learn the tools and technologies used by industry, aligning your skills with employer expectations and easing the transition into the workforce.

name: Bachelor of Exercise Science
description: Develop expertise in physical, biomedical, and psychological sciences to launch your career in exercise science. Learn the role of exercise in health maintenance and rehabilitation and how it can be applied to create interventions that improve health, fitness, wellbeing and performance. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Exercise Science Study courses in anatomy, physiology, psychology, biomechanics, nutrition and more. Learn how the body moves and how to assess human performance through exercise. Build skills to boost performance, prevent injuries, manage health risks and promote the benefits of exercise. Gain experience through placements in our on-campus clinics, or with big names like Swimming Australia, Gold Coast Titans and Queensland Academy of Sport. Graduate ready for careers in sport, health, fitness and rehab, or continue into further study like physiotherapy or clinical physiology. Learn to lead in collaborative care The best outcomes for patients and health professionals rely on a collaborative, inclusive approach to health. At Griffith, we prepare you for the future of healthcare by learning alongside students and staff from the full range of clinical areas, building crucial skills for multidisciplinary teams. The Gold Coast's home of health Griffith Health has a major presence within the Gold Coast Health and Knowledge Precinct, across the road from the Gold Coast University Hospital.

name: Bachelor of Forensic Science
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Forensic Science degree. Unlock your potential in the world of forensic science, where rigorous scientific training underpins real-world criminal investigation. Our Bachelor of Forensic Science is Queensland's only dedicated and accredited forensic science degree, designed to give you the crime scene, laboratory and investigative skills trusted by employers. With a strong science-first approach and a focus on practical learning, you'll graduate as a confident, job-ready forensic professional. You'll build strong foundations in chemistry and biology before applying them to forensic contexts - a critical advantage in a field where scientific accuracy matters. Study alongside a supportive student community, learn from approachable academics with real case experience, and connect directly with industry through guest lectures, networking events and professional bodies such as the Australian and New Zealand Forensic Science Society (ANZFSS). You'll gain a clear understanding of what forensic careers really involve and the multiple pathways available beyond traditional roles. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Forensic Science Study Queensland's only accredited forensic science degree, developed to meet industry standards and employer expectations. Build strong chemistry and biology foundations through a science-first curriculum, before applying your skills to forensic investigation. Develop the practical lab and analytical skills employers demand through extensive hands-on experience in forensic biology and chemistry. Learn to evaluate evidence objectively, using contemporary forensic analysis methods and emerging investigative technologies. Learn from industry-leading academics who have provided expert evidence in Australian courts.

Year 1: Introduction to Forensic Science, Chemistry I, Principles of Forensic Investigation, Statistics
Year 2: Forensic Laboratory Accreditation and Quality Systems, Forensic Chemistry
Year 3: Advanced Organic Chemistry, Applied Bioinformatics, Forensic Evidence and the Expert Witness

Learn from some of the country's leading designers, who are already pushing the boundaries of game design and creative arts. This program is designed to provide students with an opportunity to undertake advanced study and supervised research work in Public Health within the context of a multidisciplinary cohort. The scope of Public Health is inclusive of a broad range of specialties in many health related disciplines. The research skills developed within this program will provide an attractive credential for students seeking employment in the public or private sectors. name: Bachelor of Health Science
description: The Bachelor of Health Science at Griffith University provides an understanding of the human body and the science underpinning health practice, with high flexibility through a range of majors leading to many career paths. In first year, students build a foundation in human biology including chemistry, cell biology, anatomy, physiology, genetics, microbiology, health management, nutrition and toxicology, then in later years refine skills in analysis, evaluation and communication and select a major. The degree holds five-star ratings for skills development, student support and teaching quality. It runs three years full-time.

name: Bachelor of Human Services
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Human Services degree. Make a real difference in your community. This degree prepares you to work with individuals, families and communities to help overcome challenges in areas such as health, housing, education, employment, disability or social connection. Use your skills to support and connect people and the resources they need, and work to make systems easier to navigate and more supportive. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Human Services Explore human services in Australia and build a strong foundation in social justice, empowerment and inclusion to help shape a brighter future for those you work with. Explore courses in human development, communication and counselling, social justice and diversity, ethics and case management. Learn from specialists tackling issues such as youth mental health, parenting and family support, while gaining hands-on human services experience. Career advice and support is built into your degree, so you'll graduate job ready. Practical experience that sets you apart Put your skills into practice through clinical placements in our on-campus clinics or with leading organisations like Queensland Health, Queensland Government, headspace and Lifeline. Combine classroom learning with hands-on training Guided by experienced professionals, you'll complete 52 days of field placement across your second and third years. With opportunities in areas such as child protection, family support, mental health, youth justice, homelessness, domestic violence and disability and the option to take local, rural or international placements, you'll graduate ready to make a real impact.

Year 1: Human Services Structures, Interpersonal Skills, Human Development and Behaviour, Human Services Processes, Equity and Diversity, Introduction to Social Theory
Year 2: Case Management for Human Service and Health Professionals, First Peoples and Social Justice, Human Services Research, Community Practice Approaches
Year 3: Counselling Individuals and Families, Ethics and Professional Practice, Human Services Field Placement 2
Plus 8 elective/flexible courses chosen from an approved list to complete the 240 credit-point program.

In this field, creativity meets engineering, allowing you to turn ideas into practical solutions. Through hands-on learning, you'll master design principles and advanced manufacturing technologies, preparing you to create products that make a real impact. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Industrial Design Learn to design innovative products that improve lives in industries like healthcare and medical technology, automotive, fashion, aerospace and more. Access specialised technologies like 3D printing, digital modelling, electronics, mechanics and thermodynamics to design for both mass production and small-scale manufacturing. Build skills in both creative design and technical manufacturing, ready to take a product from idea to final result. Even if you study full-time on campus, you may be able to tailor your degree with flexible tutorials, online lectures and course materials. Connect and collaborate with industry experts Work on real industry projects and assessments while learning from our teaching staff, who bring years of professional experience to guide and mentor you. Launch your career in industrial design Graduate with an industry-ready degree that gives you the skills and knowledge to succeed. With a focus on sustainable design and professional growth, you'll be prepared to innovate and lead in industrial design at both local and global levels.

Explore how to manage teams in diverse workplaces and develop a deep understanding of the global tourism market. Get hands-on with the tools and systems used in the tourism and hospitality industry so you'll graduate with the skills and knowledge employers are looking for. If scheduled opening is delayed, courses may be delivered all or in part at our other Brisbane locations. Queensland's #1 university for law and criminology. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2025) Be the lawyer the world needs and prepare to tackle the unique challenges of our modern, high-tech, globalised society. Gain progressive, practical experience and support for your legal career, as well as access to opportunities and networks to shape your professional path. At Griffith, you'll learn the theory of law as a tool for social justice and change. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Laws (Honours) Develop in-depth knowledge of legal principles and practices, including connections between law, ethics, Indigenous issues and international perspectives. Learn essential legal skills in negotiation, critical analysis, advocacy and legal writing. Cover a range of topics in crime, contracts, property, corporate law, torts and legal theories. Learn from practicing legal educators, researchers, judges in residence and a range of industry partners. The Bachelor of Laws (Honours) is an AQF Level 8 degree, which means you'll gain advanced skills in research and critical thinking, stronger career recognition and more pathways for further study. Practical experience Griffith Law School welcomes you to the profession from the commencement of your study.

Study where the ocean meets the classroom at our Gold Coast campus and combine specialised research with hands-on fieldwork in some of Australia's most iconic marine environments. With direct access to Moreton Bay, Gold Coast waterways and Heron Island, you'll gain practical experience in a living laboratory - building the skills and networks that open doors in marine science careers worldwide. Through a broad, interdisciplinary curriculum spanning marine biology, chemistry and physical sciences, you'll graduate as a well-rounded marine science professional ready to meet industry needs. With strong industry links and opportunities to join research projects and sustainability initiatives, you'll graduate with confidence, experience and professional connections. Small cohorts, approachable lecturers and a supportive learning community ensure you're guided every step of the way. Develop practical skills through hands-on experience with industry-relevant tools and approaches, including GIS, ecological modelling, environmental economics and data analysis. Gain valuable professional experience through marine industry placement in areas such as fisheries, aquaculture, marine conservation, coastal management or coastal engineering. Build a strong science foundation in your first year before customising your studies and specialising in your area of passion in second and third year, with the flexibility to switch

name: Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science degree. Make an impact as a medical scientist. Play a key role in improving patient health by conducting diagnostic tests and recommending treatment options. As a medical scientist, you will perform tests on blood, tissues and other bodily fluids to help doctors diagnose a range of diseases, including glandular fever, diabetes, swine flu and cancer. You could also contribute to the success of clinical trials and advance healthcare innovations that will shape the future of medicine. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science Build your knowledge in core subjects like chemistry, cell biology, anatomy and physiology to understand how the body works in health and disease. From second year, focus on specialised areas and learn how to diagnose diseases while building deeper knowledge in lab science. In your final year, put your skills into practice with full-time clinical placements where you'll work on real medical cases and graduate job ready. Enter a booming job market, projected to grow over 6.5 per cent by 2028*. Develop your abilities to become a versatile and authentic performer who excels both as a collaborative company member and in the individual skills of singing, dancing and acting. Gain the skills to become a confident and capable Registered Nurse. Experience highly regarded learning with workshops, online classes and diverse clinical placements to prepare you to make a real difference in the healthcare sector. Nursing is the science of professional caring and offers opportunities to promote and restore health, prevent illness and alleviate suffering. You'll learn how to make critical decisions, coordinate care and educate patients. Through diverse clinical placements, you will develop advanced healthcare, advocacy and leadership skills. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Nursing Future-proof your skills through the latest technology and teaching approaches. Study in our on-campus simulation nursing wards and high-tech labs. Take part in interactive workshops, simulated practice, online learning and varied clinical placements. Learn alongside students and staff from the full range of clinical areas, preparing you to work across communities as part of a multidisciplinary team. Enhance your skills through evidence-based care, focusing on nursing as a profession, while gaining exposure to various nursing specialties and receiving integrated employment support. We produce the highest-quality graduates in the profession, supported by our culture of excellence in teaching, research and clinical practice. Exciting clinical placements from the get-go Undertake work-integrated clinical placements with a difference.

name: Bachelor of Paramedicine
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Paramedicine degree. Study the fast-moving, rewarding field of paramedicine, where you can make a real difference in people's lives. This degree equips you with the essential skills and knowledge to work as a paramedic in traditional and non-traditional settings. You'll develop strong clinical decision-making, problem-solving and critical thinking skills, while gaining a deep understanding of the human body, paramedic practice and the care of diverse conditions, diseases and trauma. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Paramedicine Our small student intake means more personalised support, more opportunities for active participation and meaningful interaction and a closer connection with teaching staff. Our simulation facilities give you authentic, hands-on clinical experience using the same equipment as the Queensland Ambulance Service and other paramedicine organisations in Australia and overseas. Graduate prepared to confidently respond to a wide range of situations, helping to improve health and wellbeing. Open doors to international opportunities, allowing you to work in different countries and grow your career in paramedicine. Practical paramedicine experience Experience a variety of clinical placements that build your hands-on skills across different healthcare settings. You'll complete ambulance placements-4 weeks at the end of your first and second years, and 6 weeks in your final year-on a four on, four off roster. Non-ambulance placements are also available, giving you a well-rounded understanding of healthcare challenges and helping you refine your professional practice.

This degree gives you the scientific expertise to understand how drugs and chemicals interact with the human body. With a strong focus on practical learning and real-world application, this degree prepares you for a career at the intersection of health, science and industry. Through hands-on lab work and applied projects, you'll build a deep understanding of pharmacology, toxicology and drug development, gaining insight into how safer and more effective treatments reach patients and communities. Apply your learning to real challenges through project-based courses such as the BioHealth Project, working with industry, government or research partners. Tailor your studies with electives that align with your interests across health, research, regulation or industry. Practical learning with real impact From your first year, you'll combine core health science courses with lab-based learning to understand how cells, tissues and organ systems respond to medicines and chemicals.

description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Political Science and International Relations degree. The Brisbane South (Nathan) offering of this program is scheduled to be delivered at the Treasury Building at our Brisbane City campus in 2027. If scheduled opening is delayed, courses may be delivered all or in part at our other Brisbane locations. Queensland's #1 university for political science. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2025) A Bachelor of Political Science and International Relations will provide you with a deep understanding of policy, politics and power in the domestic and international spheres. You'll learn about political movements and institutions, processes of law making, diplomacy and global politics. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Political Science and International Relations Start your journey to becoming a global leader in politics and international relations. Learn about political systems, institutions and global diplomacy, gaining a deep understanding of the forces shaping local and global politics. Explore how democracy thrives, or struggles to survive, and the strategies authoritarian leaders increasingly use to maintain their grip on power. Take your studies overseas with international internships, study abroad programs and global partnerships. You'll build cultural awareness, grow your professional network and gain a competitive edge for your future career. Learn from

name: Bachelor of Primary Education
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Primary Education degree. This degree is pending accreditation with the Queensland College of Teachers (QCT). Everyone has that one teacher that always believed in them. Be that teacher for your students and help create a brighter future for the next generation. You'll learn the knowledge and skills to teach prep to Year 6 and cover areas such as humanities and social science, the way language develops and works, mathematics, science and technology, health and physical education, and the arts. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Primary Education A shared foundation year, between the Bachelor of Early Childhood and Primary Education, Bachelor of Primary Education and Bachelor of Secondary Education, to develop key insights into major trends and themes in education. This shared foundation year allows for a seamless transition between degrees, giving you time to decide which age group you feel most comfortable teaching. Benefit from our strong relationships with schools and industry partners. During your studies, you will undertake 80 days of supervised professional experience and we have a dedicated placement officer to assist in organising your placement. Choose to specialise with your choice of electives and major. Learn at your own pace, with flexible options including online learning you may be able to fast-track your studies. Once the degree is accredited, eligible students can apply for Queensland teacher registration as soon as they graduate.
curriculum:
Year 1: Understanding the Lifelong Learner, Indigenous Perspectives in Education, Becoming an Educator, Foundations of Curriculum, Assessment and Planning, Educational Technologies and Relational Communication, Teaching as a Profession
Year 2: Technologies Education, Health and Physical Education, Arts Education 1, Foundations of Primary Science Education, Mathematics Education 1, Early Years Reading and Writing, Managing Learning, Primary Education Language and Literature, Mathematics Education 2
Year 3: Humanities and Social Sciences, Primary Science Education 2, English Education 3
Year 4: Research-Informed Teaching of Reading, First Australians and the education system, The Griffith Graduate Teacher, Reflecting and responding as a professional
Plus 6 elective/flexible courses chosen from an approved list to complete the 320 credit-point program.

name: Bachelor of Psychological Science
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Psychological Science degree. Do you want to uncover what drives people's thoughts, feelings and actions? The Bachelor of Psychological Science gives you a solid foundation in psychological theory, research methods and applications. You'll explore processes that shape human behaviour across a variety of contexts, from development and cognition to mental health and social behaviour. With a flexible degree structure, you can shape your studies by choosing electives that complement psychology and open diverse career pathways, from business and HR to criminology, sport science and beyond. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Psychological Science Study a mix of psychology disciplines, guided by experienced researchers and industry professionals. Learn to design research studies, collect and analyse data and contribute to impactful research. Develop practical skills and explore concepts across counselling, communication, group facilitation and behaviour change

name: Bachelor of Psychology (Honours)
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Psychology (Honours) degree. Understand the human mind to support the mental health of others. The Bachelor of Psychology (Honours) will give you a thorough grounding in clinical, developmental, biological, cognitive, social, and organisational psychology and research. This degree will enable you to work towards a career as a psychologist, or work in related fields in the health sector and beyond. Meet the demand for caring professionals to support the mental wellbeing of individuals, families and communities. You'll learn to help people with personal, health, vocational and social difficulties and apply theory to topics including thinking and perceiving, motivation, stress and group behaviour. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Psychology (Honours) Build the cultural competence and practical skills to support individuals and communities. Learn to conduct and interpret tests that measure intellectual, behavioural and emotional states then apply the results for more positive outcomes. Connect with experts who undertake groundbreaking research in our Centre for Mental Health, including in key areas such as youth mental health, parenting and family interventions. Undertake practical learning with experienced professionals from different fields to understand how various professions apply psychology in practice. With opportunities for research, placements and collaborative projects you'll graduate ready for a career that makes a difference. Honours To be eligible for progression to the fourth year of the Bachelor of Psychology (Honours), you'll need to achieve the required level of academic performance in the earlier years of the degree.
curriculum:
Year 1: Introduction to Psychology 1, Interpersonal Skills, Psychology and Counselling in Professional Contexts, Introduction to Psychology 2, Research Methods and Statistics in Psychology, Counselling Skills
Year 2: Experimental Design and Analysis, Biological Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Cognitive Psychology, Social and Cultural Psychology, Group Facilitation and Coaching Skills
Year 3: Survey Design and Analysis, Behaviour Change Skills, Psychological Assessment of Individual Differences, Abnormal Psychology
Year 6: Issues in Quantitative Research, Professional Psychology A, Honours Research Project, Honours Research Project, Professional Psychology B, Advanced Topics in Psychology
Plus 32 elective/flexible courses chosen from an approved list to complete the 320 credit-point program.

name: Bachelor of Public Health
description: Make a real impact by tackling today's most pressing health challenges and improving the wellbeing of communities. The Bachelor of Public Health provides the knowledge and skills to promote health, prevent disease and create healthier environments for people everywhere. You'll learn how social, environmental and economic factors influence health and how to design programs and policies that make a lasting difference. Griffith is ranked #1 in Australia and #2 globally in the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)*, a universal framework for providing health and education for all. This reflects our commitment to creating healthier, fairer and more sustainable societies. As a Griffith public health graduate, you'll be ready to contribute to meaningful change across Australia and internationally. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Public Health Build your understanding of major health issues including chronic disease, sexual health, nutrition, HIV/AIDS, physical inactivity and drug and alcohol abuse, in settings such as workplaces, hospitals and schools. Learn in specialised simulation labs and virtual environments alongside students from other health degrees for authentic team-based learning. Be taught by experts leading research in areas like health promotion, epidemiology, climate change and disease prevention. Explore the world with international study tours and exchanges. Step into your career ready to drive change Start building your career from day one with mentoring, networking and practical skills that employers look for. This degree integrates employability at every stage to ensure you're career ready.
curriculum:
Year 1: Interpersonal Skills, Introduction to Public Health, Foundational Anatomy and Physiology, Research Methods and Statistics in Psychology, Introduction to Social Theory, Health Challenges for the 21st Century
Year 2: Priorities and Interventions in Health Promotion, Epidemiology, Health Research Methods, Needs Assessment, Program Planning and Evaluation
Year 3: Healthcare for Australia's First Peoples, Community Engagement in Public Health, Public Health Professional Practice, Public Health Practicum, Planetary Health Policy and Practice
Plus 18 elective/flexible courses chosen from an approved list to complete the 240 credit-point program.

name: Bachelor of Quantum Electronic Engineering (Honours)
description: Be part of the next big leap in science and innovation. Shape the future of technology with Queensland's first undergraduate quantum electronic engineering degree. If you're a high-achieving, curious mind excited by specialised technology, this degree offers an opportunity to turn your passion into a future-focused career. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Quantum Electronic Engineering at Griffith This is the only undergraduate degree of its kind in Queensland, designed for the fast-growing quantum technology industry. Gain skills to help solve the complex problems facing science, technology and society, including how to use quantum computing to reduce our energy needs. Blend electrical engineering fundamentals with advanced quantum physics, giving you a unique edge in the tech sector. Enrich your understanding with close industry collaborations, including Griffith's partnership with PsiQuantum , a global leader in quantum computing. Get hands-on experience and exposure to industry trends through guest lectures, research projects, and placement opportunities. Leverage world-leading research Your degree is underpinned by the exciting research and facilities from Griffith's Queensland Quantum and Advanced Technologies Research Institute (QUATRI) . This research hub has been a leader in quantum technologies for over two decades. You'll learn from experts and researchers who are leading projects in quantum engineering, quantum communications, and sensing-pillars of Australia's National Quantum Strategy. One-of-a-kind facilities and labs Work in highly regarded facilities like Australia's only silicon carbide-on-silicon microfabrication centre and the country's premier attosecond laser lab. You'll get to work on real problems using advanced tools, simulations and labs, preparing you to work with emerging technologies that could transform industries.

Year 1: Engineering Mathematics 1, Engineering Materials, Engineering Science, Engineering Design Practice, Engineering Mathematics 2, Digital Systems, Physics 1B, Electric Circuits
Year 2: Calculus II, Introduction to Electronics, Quantum Mechanics, Relativity and Elementary Particles, Engineering C, Embedded Systems, Electromagnetism and Optics, Signals and Systems, Modern Physics Laboratory
Year 3: Project Management Principles, Control Systems, Quantum Physics III, Electrical and Electronic Design Project, Physics Laboratory III, Condensed Matter Physics, Electromagnetic Waves and Propagation
Year 6: Communication Systems, IAP
Year 7: Discrete Time Signal Processing, Advanced Communications Systems, Advanced Computer Systems
Plus 2 elective/flexible courses chosen from an approved list to complete the 320 credit-point program.

name: Bachelor of Social Work
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Social Work degree. Want to help people and drive change at a local, national or global level? Feel passionate about social justice and human rights? Study our Bachelor of Social Work and be the change that helps people and communities when they need it most. The Bachelor of Social Work equips you with the tools to turn your passion into a rewarding career. You'll learn how to work effectively with individuals, families, and communities, helping people navigate complex challenges and advocating for human rights and social justice. With a strong foundation in ethics, human behaviour, social policy and programs, you'll graduate prepared to lead positive change across sectors such as mental health, child protection, aged care, disability services, homelessness, First Nations support and more. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Social Work Learn from teaching staff with deep industry expertise and experience in fields such as mental health, domestic violence, disability, child protection and advocacy. Explore key areas of social work including counselling, group work, community development, social policy, ethics, program evaluation and human rights. Gain strong foundations in human development, equity and diversity, and the social systems that shape people's lives. Flexible options may be available for those already working in the field, including recognition of prior learning or workplace-based placements. Real-world experience that prepares you for practice You'll complete two professional field placements during your degree, gaining 1,000 hours of supervised experience in the sector.
curriculum:
Year 1: Human Services Structures, Interpersonal Skills, Human Development and Behaviour, Human Services Processes, Introduction to Social Theory, Equity and Diversity
Year 2: Case Management for Human Service and Health Professionals, Social Construction of Welfare, Group Facilitation, First Peoples and Social Justice, Human Services Research, Community Practice Approaches
Year 3: Social Work Field Placement 1, Social Work 1, Social Work in Health and Mental Health, Ethics and Professional Practice, Effective Disability Practice, Working with Family Violence, Influencing Policy and Legislation, Counselling Individuals and Families, Evaluation, Effectiveness, Outcomes
Year 4: Developing Practice and Leadership, Social Work Field Placement 2, Critical Reflective Practice
Plus 8 elective/flexible courses chosen from an approved list to complete the 320 credit-point program.

name: Bachelor of Software Engineering (Honours)
description: Griffith University's Bachelor of Software Engineering (Honours) degree. Build the future of technology with a Bachelor of Software Engineering If you want a hand in designing and implementing the software systems our society depends on, our Bachelor of Software Engineering is the ideal degree for you. You'll begin by building a solid foundation in computer systems, engineering principles, mathematics and information systems, laying the groundwork for your future career in software engineering. As one of the first universities in Australia to offer a Software Engineering degree, we continue to lead in innovation nearly 30 years on, so you can be confident you'll develop industry-relevant practical skills. This includes the chance to develop software for real clients. In your final year, you will spend over half of your time on work-integrated learning through industry projects, preparing you for a successful career. Highlights of studying Software Engineering A focus on industry engagement in everything we teach ensures the knowledge and skills you gain are directly relevant to your future career in the tech industry, helping you bridge the gap between theory and practice. You'll develop essential skills in teamwork, project management and quality control by working on real-world projects. These experiences will help you build practical expertise and prepare you for the challenges you'll face in your professional career. Gain valuable insights firsthand into industry practices including how leaders tackle problems, through a variety of field trips.

Year 2: Computing Algorithms, Engineering C, Software Projects, Object Oriented Software Development, Embedded Systems, Secure Development Operations
Year 3: Ethical Hacking, Agile Methodologies, Co-Design Incubator, Full Stack Development, Project Management Principles, Computer Systems, Work Integrated Learning - Single Project, Mobile Application Development, Programming for Robotics, Digital Forensics, Sensors and Actuators
Year 6: IAP
Year 7: Advanced Computer Systems, SCADA Systems, Image Processing and Machine Vision

name: Bachelor of Sport Development
description: Turn your passion for sport into a rewarding career with strong job prospects. With Griffith's five-star rating for teaching quality, student support and learning resources in the field of sports and leisure*, you'll be prepared to stand out and succeed in an industry that's constantly evolving and expanding. Highlights of studying the Bachelor of Sport Development Build a strong foundation in sport development covering sport science, management, marketing, health promotion, exercise programming and coaching. Study the specialist field of community development through sport, learning how to design pathways to attract, keep and support participants at all levels. Gain skills to create, run and manage recreational programs for communities and development pathways for elite athletes. Explore sport, health and fitness through physiology, biomechanics, sport psychology, sociology, management, policy, coaching and fitness studies. Shape study around your life, with flexible tutorial times and online access to lectures and course material. Learn in highly regarded sports facilities Work and learn alongside students, staff and top researchers using the latest technology and simulations. At Australia's #1 university for elite athletes**, you'll have access to professional-grade facilities, including an Olympic swimming pool, athletics track and high-tech labs. You'll also be well-placed to gain experience and opportunities leading up to the Brisbane 2032 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

name: Bachelor of Visual Arts
description: The Bachelor of Visual Arts will equip you with the historical, theoretical and practical knowledge to begin a career in the visual arts, either in Australia or internationally. In your first year, you'll undertake introductory courses in painting, sculpture, performance and installation, photography, drawing and contemporary Australian Indigenous art. First-year students may also undertake elective courses such as printmaking or jewellery and small objects. In your second year, you'll select a major and tailor your studies with electives such as public art, international study tours, museum and gallery internships, or courses from other Griffith degrees. By third year, you'll deepen your expertise in your major while developing essential professional practice skills, including producing a major cross-disciplinary project and showcasing your work in an exhibition.
curriculum:

name: Doctor of Clinical Dentistry
description: Griffith's Doctor of Clinical Dentistry is a 240-credit-point degree, three years full-time, taught at the Gold Coast, for qualified dentists specialising in endodontics or periodontics. It combines rigorous clinical practice with academic coursework and research to train specialists for advanced patient care: the endodontics major covers diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the tooth pulp and surrounding tissues, and the periodontics major covers prevention, diagnosis and treatment of gum and supporting-structure disease. Entry is a bachelor degree in dentistry, current professional registration, relevant work experience and an interview, and IELTS 7.0. The degree is accredited by the Australian Dental Council. Graduates practise as registered dental specialists. Indicative international tuition is around A$77,000 per year.

name: Doctor of Education
description: The Doctor of Education at Griffith University is designed for experienced educators and professionals and combines advanced research with practical application, preparing graduates to influence practice, policy and innovation across educational settings including schools, higher education, government and community organisations. Guided by experienced supervisors, students plan and undertake a significant research project addressing contemporary educational issues, building advanced skills in problem-solving, research design and critical inquiry. It runs three years full-time.

name: Doctor of Medicine
description: Join a medical program driven by a commitment to providing exceptional healthcare for all communities. Through dynamic team-based learning, hands-on clinical skills sessions, and immersive clinical placements, you'll gain the expertise, confidence and compassion needed to thrive as an intern. Graduating as a skilled, caring and capable medical professional, you'll be ready to make a lasting impact in the medical field and contribute to a healthier future for all. Immerse yourself in clinical experiences from the outset through our General Practice Longitudinal Program (GPLP), as well as community and in-hospital settings. Take part in extensive clinical placements and community work experiences at leading hospitals and clinics across South East Queensland and Northern New South Wales, ranging from rural settings through to the Gold Coast University Hospital and the Sunshine Coast Hospital and Health Service. This program is delivered in collaboration with Rural Medical Education Australia (RuralMedEd) at the Toowoomba location. Highlights of studying the Doctor of Medicine at Griffith The Doctor of Medicine is accredited by the Australian Medical Council. Learn how to serve diverse populations through community-focused care. Teaching includes masterclasses led by visiting experts, renowned national leaders with practical, first-hand experience in their fields. Develop communication and clinical reasoning skills essential for effective patient assessment, while learning about the art and science of medicine in its wider social and ethical context. Master your skills in our wide variety of teaching environments, including specialised facilities, virtual reality and learning simulations.
curriculum: Compulsory courses: Introduction to Clinical Practice 1, Community Medicine and Professional Practice 1, Foundations of Medicine 1, Introduction to Clinical Practice 2, Community Medicine and Professional Practice 2, Foundations of Medicine 2, Introduction to Clinical Practice 3, Community Medicine and Professional Practice 3, Foundations of Medicine 3, Advanced Communication, Law and Ethics, Preparation for Research, Transition to Clinical Practice, Clinical Medicine Year 3, Clinical Medicine Year 3, Clinical Medicine Year 4, Clinical Medicine Year 4
admission_requirements: Any Bachelor degree or other key degree (5.0 GPA) and GAMSAT (minimum score of 50 in each section) or MCAT (123 in each section)

name: Doctor of Philosophy in Clinical Psychology
description: The Doctor of Philosophy in Clinical Psychology at Griffith University integrates traditional PhD research training, through the preparation of a thesis, with coursework and internship training in the theory and techniques of clinical psychology. Graduates are prepared for specialist careers in clinical research settings, including universities, hospitals, research foundations and government bodies. The program is designed to meet the requirements for full registration with the Psychology Board of Australia and entry to the registrar program for area of practice endorsement in clinical psychology. Students must hold and maintain provisional or full registration as a psychologist. It runs four years full-time.

name: Doctor of Visual Arts
description: The Doctor of Visual Arts at Griffith University is a professional development degree with an integrated program of independent research and coursework that helps practising artists extend their studio research and practice and make original conceptual advances in their discipline. Students develop the expertise to provide leadership in their field, along with research skills and the ability to articulate a theoretical position within a visual arts discourse. It runs three to four years full-time at the Queensland College of Art and Design.

name: Graduate Certificate in Aviation Management
description: Griffith University's Graduate Certificate in Aviation Management degree. Become an aviation industry expert with a Graduate Certificate in Aviation Management. Designed for aspiring and working aviation professionals, this qualification strengthens your management capability, commercial insight and operational knowledge in one of the world's most highly regulated sectors. Highlights of studying the Graduate Certificate in Aviation Management Develop foundational knowledge in aviation management, airport operations and industry governance. Learn practical skills in aviation marketing, planning and strategic decision-making. Understand how to use safety science to enhance the organisation's safety performance in safety-critical environments. Get first-hand insights from industry-informed academics and guest lecturers with aviation experience and learn how airports and aviation organisations are run. Graduate in just six months with full-time study. A strong foundation in aviation management Explore the complex commercial, operational and management environment of the aviation sector, from airline management to airport planning and regulation. Foundation courses introduce aviation management principles: leadership, technology, safety and risk management, cost structures and global competition. As a graduate, you'll be able to apply your knowledge, analyse markets, position services and use data to inform strategic business decisions. Pathway to further study Whether you're looking to advance your career, transition into the aviation industry or specialise further with the Master of Aviation Management (5776) , this graduate certificate sets out a pathway into postgraduate aviation study, with completed courses often credited toward the full masters degree.

name: Graduate Certificate in Public Health
description: The Graduate Certificate in Public Health at Griffith University develops an understanding of how local, national and international health systems are structured and operate, so graduates can plan and deliver effective programs to address challenging health issues. The program focuses on the socio-ecological model of public health and the interactions between social, biological, economic and environmental determinants of health, with the opportunity to research, plan, implement and evaluate population-based interventions. A diverse range of core and elective courses, including nutrition, health promotion, environmental health and program planning, lets students tailor their studies. It can be completed in six months of full-time study.

name: Graduate Certificate in Urban and Environmental Planning
description: The Graduate Certificate in Urban and Environmental Planning at Griffith University addresses planning issues central to contemporary practice, broadening and deepening professional understanding of practical and theoretical responses to planning challenges across environmental, development, land use, transport, policy and strategic planning. description: The Graduate Diploma of Clinical Physiology at Griffith University provides in-depth clinical training and professional experience through hospital or clinic-based clinical placements. description: Griffith University's Graduate Diploma of Criminological Research Studies degree. The program provides the necessary preparation for entry into a higher degree research program (Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), Master of Philosophy (MPhil) or equivalent program) for applicants who do not possess the required qualifications for direct admission into these programs. The Program Director will be responsible for the overall supervision of students in the program and for monitoring their progress throughout the program. Students may choose to exit the Graduate Diploma program (after successfully completing the specified courses) with the Graduate Certificate in Criminological Research Studies.

name: Juris Doctor
description: Queensland's #1 university for law and criminology. (ShanghaiRanking's Global Ranking of Academic Subjects 2025) Prepare for a rewarding legal career with Griffith's Juris Doctor, a graduate-entry program designed for students from diverse academic backgrounds. Whether your goal is to practise law, work in government or influence policy, this degree provides the knowledge, skills and practical experiences to succeed. Highlights of studying the Juris Doctor Future-proof your career with the option of completing a major in Canadian law, international law, or migration law. Study crime, contracts, torts, constitutional and property law while building skills in reasoning, advocacy, research and ethics. Choose from a wide range of electives that match your career aspirations ranging from environmental law, digital media, cyber law, family law, competition and consumer law, human rights and international arbitration. This program can be completed in two years by taking courses across each trimester. Practical legal experience from day one Work alongside experienced lawyers and participate in immersive, practical experiences including law clinics and the Innocence Project , where you'll apply your knowledge to real cases. These opportunities ensure you graduate with the confidence to navigate both the courtroom and complex legal systems. A highly regarded legal education Ranked among the world's top law schools, we're recognised for our commitment to social justice, ethical practice and innovation in legal education. You'll learn from leading academics and practising lawyers who bring real-world expertise into the classroom.

name: Master of Advanced Health Services Management
description: Griffith University's Master of Advanced Health Services Management degree. Designed for experienced health professionals and managers, the Master of Advanced Health Services Management builds high-level expertise in healthcare leadership, governance and system reform across health, aged and community care sectors. If you're ready to move beyond operational management into senior and executive roles, this advanced degree provides the strategic, financial and policy capability required to lead complex health services in Australia and globally. Highlights of studying the Master of Advanced Health Services Management Build high-level capability in health services management, leadership and strategic decision making. Examine contemporary challenges in healthcare management while strengthening your ability to influence performance, accountability and long-term sustainability. Develop expertise in healthcare finance, budgeting and resource allocation. Apply health economics to support value-based care and measurable service improvement. Explore digital health, information systems and technology-enabled models of care. Choose your study pathway (electives, dissertation or work-based learning) and develop your research capability to support progression to PhD study. Prepare for senior health leadership The advanced structure of this degree includes dedicated foundation studies in applied ethics and law, health system design, health services and information systems, and risk management in healthcare. Combined with courses in leadership, change management and strategic decision making in health, you'll gain a deep understanding of the policy environments, governance structures and performance frameworks that underpin healthcare systems. You'll be positioned to guide organisations through reform, workforce challenges and increasing service demand.

name: Master of Architecture
description: Griffith University's Master of Architecture degree. Explore the world of architectural design, where creative vision meets research-driven practice. Our Master of Architecture is accredited by the Board of Architects, and it is your first requirement on your path to registration. It equips you with advanced design skills, critical thinking and industry-ready experience so you can contribute to the future of Australian and global built environments. With a strong focus on design research, sustainable thinking and professional practice, this degree prepares you to succeed in your chosen industry. Highlights of studying the Master of Architecture Build advanced expertise in sustainable design, urban design, building technologies and architectural theory. Develop a research-driven design practice through intensive studio work and design-led inquiry. Learn to investigate and analyse complex design challenges using evidence-informed, creative and culturally responsive approaches. Strengthen your technical capabilities in documentation, construction systems and environmental technologies. Gain professional skills through dedicated practice courses exploring ethics, regulatory frameworks and the realities of architectural work. Complete work-integrated learning placements in leading design practices, gaining practical experience in project delivery, client engagement and studio operations. Hands-on experience in architectural design and research Across workshops, studios and professional practice courses, you'll engage with complex design problems and develop creative solutions grounded in research. You'll explore advanced construction systems, adaptive design strategies and environmentally conscious technologies while refining your ability to communicate ideas through drawings, models and digital tools.

Plus 4 elective/flexible courses chosen from an approved list to complete the 160 credit-point program.

name: Master of Aviation Management
description: Griffith's Master of Aviation Management is a 160-credit-point degree, one to two years full-time, taught online and at Brisbane South, for aviation professionals and graduates aiming at leadership roles with airlines, airports and aviation organisations. Study covers aviation economics, safety management systems, human factors, and strategic airline and airport management, with a focus on innovation, operational performance and responding to regulatory and market pressure. Entry is a recognised bachelor degree, with IELTS 6.5. Graduates take senior roles in airline operations and management, airport management and strategic planning, aviation safety and quality management, regulatory and compliance leadership, and aviation consultancy. Indicative international tuition is around A$43,500 per year.

name: Master of Biotechnology
description: The Master of Biotechnology at Griffith University is designed for graduate or professional scientists who want to extend their skills and knowledge in clinical and environmental microbiology, bioinformatics, protein science, molecular biology and genomics, and apply it in a competitive commercial environment. It also suits scientists who wish to become business or research managers and entrepreneurs in biotechnology, with applications across clinical, agriculture, food and environmental fields. It runs one to two years full-time depending on entry point.

name: Master of Building Services
discontinued_note: The Master of Building Services has been discontinued with no live listing or direct successor found in Griffith's current degree search.

name: Master of Business
description: Griffith's Master of Business is a 160-credit-point degree, one to two years full-time, taught at Brisbane South, Gold Coast and online. It is a flexible generalist business qualification for professionals moving into management, changing fields, or formalising experience, and students choose one of twelve majors including accounting, business analytics, human resource management, international business, management, marketing, supply chain management and sport management. Study covers leadership for sustainable business, global markets, digital transformation and emerging workforce trends, and a dissertation pathway can lead into higher research study. Entry is a recognised bachelor degree, with IELTS 6.5. Graduates move into management and leadership roles in strategy, operations, consulting, policy and analytics across the corporate, government and not-for-profit sectors. Indicative international tuition is around A$41,000 per year.

name: Master of Business Administration
description: The redesigned, fully online Griffith MBA will commence in Trimester 1, 2027, offering a fresh and flexible way to advance your career. If you're ready to start sooner, you can begin your Griffith MBA studies in 2026, available on-campus or online. Our MBA is for leaders ready to create meaningful change. It offers a practice rich curriculum to elevate your career and sharpen skills that matter. You'll need to think differently, apply your learning in real-time and make decisions to drive impact. You'll engage with CEOs, industry leaders and innovative organisations in a range of unique projects, stretching your critical leadership skills. Co-designed with leading academics and industry experts, the Griffith MBA continues a strong focus on responsible leadership, sustainable business practices and having a global perspective. You'll develop strategic insight and an ethical mindset to lead any organisation through complexity and drive innovation. This next generation MBA is delivered online to give ambitious professionals the flexibility to study without compromising their career development. Whether you want to be a senior leader, scale your own venture or influence policy and strategy, the Griffith MBA will help you step into the role of a bold, informed and ethical decision-maker. Highlights of studying the Griffith MBA Go global with select students given the opportunity to attend the European Summer School for Advanced Management, hosted at the University of Glasgow, Scotland.
curriculum:
Compulsory courses: Sustainability and Systems Thinking, Marketing for a Better World, Finance for Responsible Value Creation, Accounting for Accountability, Economics for a Sustainable Future, Developing Values-based Leadership, Leading for Sustainable People Outcomes, Strategy for Purpose
Plus 41 elective/flexible courses chosen from an approved list to complete the 120 credit-point program.
