The course sits within the UTS Faculty of Design, Architecture and Building and is designed mainly as a pathway into the UTS Master of Planning. It suits people testing a move into planning or building the background needed for the masters.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15142 Property Development Process; 17700 Planning and Environmental Law; 15146 Sustainable Urban Development.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's, bachelor honours degree, or master's degree, or overseas equivalent OR Completed UTS Graduate Certificate or UTS Graduate Diploma in Property Development with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian Graduate Certificate or Graduate Diploma, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian Graduate Certificate or Graduate Diploma, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study with a minimum GPA of 5/7 AND A minimum of 1 year full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Professional Accounting
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Professional Accounting at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-subject course covering accounting for managerial decisions, financial management, contemporary business law and economics for management. It is designed for graduates from non-accounting disciplines who want a foundation in accounting, finance, economics and law, either for managerial work or as a bridge into the Master of Professional Accounting.
Study takes one semester full-time. The content is developed with UTS industry partners and focuses on the practical skills used in day-to-day accounting and financial roles. Graduates move into assistant accountant, financial analyst and finance officer positions, or continue into the masters for professional body recognition.
curriculum: Core subjects — 22747 Accounting for Managerial Decisions; 25742 Financial Management; 79708 Contemporary Business Law; 23706 Economics for Management.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or overseas equivalent, in a field of study other than Accounting OR A minimum of 4 years full-time or equivalent part-time, relevant post-secondary professional work experience AND a general capacity to undertake tertiary education Relevant professional work experience refers to any current professional work experience in which you have developed skills, knowledge, and competencies directly related to the course for which you are applying.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Professional Legal Practice
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Professional Legal Practice at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is the practical legal training required for admission as a lawyer in New South Wales, taken after a qualifying law degree. From 2026 the NSW Legal Profession Admission Board requires 15 days on campus and 15 days of practical experience.
Students complete three core coursework subjects on professional skills and contemporary legal practice, plus a supervised work placement. The course satisfies the practical legal training requirements for admission to the Supreme Court of NSW. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 75422 Property and Commercial Practice; 75423 Litigation Practice; 75424 Skills and Wills Practice.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian Bachelor of Laws, Australian Juris Doctor, or NSW Legal Profession Admission Board Diploma in Law within the past 5 years OR Completed Australian Bachelor of Laws, Australian Juris Doctor, or NSW Legal Profession Admission Board Diploma in Law more than 5 years ago AND A written assessment of the legal qualification from the NSW Legal Profession Admission Board (LPAB) to ensure the qualification meets the current LPAB admission requirements OR Completed overseas legal qualification AND A written assessment from the NSW Legal Profession Admissions Board (LPAB)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Project Management
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Project Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers four core subjects: project integration management; scope, time and cost management; communication, HR and stakeholders; and risk, procurement and quality management. Over one semester full-time, students build a foundation in the full project life cycle and in leading teams through each stage.
The course is accredited by the Global Accreditation Center for Project Management Education Programs (GAC). It suits professionals taking on project responsibilities in any sector, from banking and government to events and consulting, and articulates into the UTS Master of Project Management.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15312 Project Communication, HR and Stakeholders; 15319 Project Risk, Procurement and Quality Management; 15316 Project Scope, Time and Cost Management; 15310 Project Integration Management.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, or Advanced Diploma in Project Management AND Any relevant professional work experience.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Property Development
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Property Development at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a one-semester introduction to the property development process, covering development feasibility, property transactions, and investment and development analysis. Students model a real development feasibility project and study the economic, legal and environmental factors behind urban development.
The course is designed both as a foundation qualification and as a pathway for people already working in property who lack a relevant bachelor's degree. It sits within the UTS Faculty of Design and Society and leads into the Graduate Diploma and Master of Property Development. Graduates work across government planning, valuation, development and construction.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15142 Property Development Process; 12518 Property Transactions; 12535 Property Investment and Development Feasibility.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Quantitative Finance
description: The Graduate Certificate in Quantitative Finance at UTS is for aspiring and established quantitative finance professionals navigating a financial landscape marked by rapid innovation, new risks and major regulatory change. Students obtain core mathematical competencies in time series modelling and stochastic calculus, then explore areas such as financial instruments, derivative securities, quantitative risk management, quantitative portfolio analysis, and interest rate and credit risk modelling. Learning combines current, industry-relevant subjects with hands-on experience, preparing graduates for roles in financial institutions, consulting and government.

name: Graduate Certificate in Science
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Science at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-subject entry point into postgraduate science study. Students choose two electives in their preferred scientific discipline and complete two professional subjects that prepare them for scientific practice.
The course sits within the UTS Faculty of Science, which has laboratory facilities including the Super Lab, and articulates into the UTS master's programs in science. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 68109 Advanced Communication Skills in Science; 60117 Understanding Data and Statistical Design.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Screen Arts and Production: Documentary
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Screen Arts and Production: Documentary at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a three-subject course, one core unit and two electives, focused on documentary storytelling and unscripted content. Teaching is studio-based and led by industry practitioners, and electives cover directing, cinematography, editing, producing, curation or an industry internship.
The course suits media professionals upskilling, screen production graduates specialising, or newcomers building a marketable skill. It articulates into the UTS Master of Screen Arts and Production. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in Society and Culture or Creative Arts OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in any field of study AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience in the screen industry AND An interest in the course and demonstrated understanding of the opportunities present in Screen Arts and Production OR A minimum of 4 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience in the screen industry.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Screen Arts and Production: Drama
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Screen Arts and Production: Drama at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a three-subject course, one core unit and two electives, covering scripted screen production from ideation through design, planning and production. Electives cover screen directing, cinematography, editing, curation, creative producing or an industry internship.
Study is flexible, full-time or part-time. The course articulates into the UTS Master of Screen Arts and Production. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in Society and Culture or Creative Arts OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in any field of study AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience in the screen industry AND An interest in the course and demonstrated understanding of the opportunities present in Screen Arts and Production OR A minimum of 4 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience in the screen industry.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Speech and Language Sciences
description: The Graduate Certificate in Speech and Language Sciences at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Speech Pathology can apply to transfer into this course after completing 24 credit points of specified study and graduate with a graduate certificate. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Speech Pathology provides the professional training for a career as a speech pathologist, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Certificate in Strategic Supply Chain Management
description:
The Graduate Certificate in Strategic Supply Chain Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-subject introduction to operations and supply chain management, covering strategic supply chain management, operations and quality management, supply chain risk management, and business and social impact. Teaching combines theory with practical application so students can use the material directly at work.
The course takes one semester full-time and is aimed at professionals moving into procurement, logistics, inventory and operations roles. It provides a pathway into the UTS Master of Strategic Supply Chain Management.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21797 Strategic Supply Chain Management; 21741 Operations and Quality Management; 21947 Supply Chain Risk Management.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent OR A minimum of 4 years full-time or equivalent part-time, relevant post-secondary professional work experience AND a general capacity to undertake tertiary education Relevant professional work experience refers to any current professional work experience in which you have developed skills, knowledge, and competencies directly related to the course for which you are applying. This includes roles such as managers, professionals, technicians, community, personal service, clerical, administrative, or sales workers across various industries.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in TESOL
description:
The Graduate Certificate in TESOL at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is an initial teaching qualification for people who want to teach English as an additional language to adults, to primary and secondary students, or to international students in Australia and overseas. It also gives qualified school teachers a specialisation in the area.
Students complete four core subjects on language, multilingualism and TESOL methodology, plus a supervised practicum in a real teaching setting. Study takes one semester full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have a: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Certificate in Vision Science
description: The Graduate Certificate in Vision Science at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Orthoptics can apply to transfer into this course after completing 24 credit points of specified study and graduate with a graduate certificate. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Orthoptics provides the clinical training for a career as an orthoptist, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Certificate of Data Science in Quantitative Finance
Graduate Diploma in Applied Human Studies
description: The Graduate Diploma in Applied Human Studies at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Physiotherapy can apply to transfer into this course after completing 48 credit points of specified study and graduate with a graduate diploma. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Physiotherapy covers musculoskeletal, neurological, orthopaedic and cardiorespiratory physiotherapy, evidence-based and professional practice, and clinical placements, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Diploma in Architecture
description: The Graduate Diploma in Architecture at UTS is for individuals who started a Master of Architecture but wish to pursue a non-licensing qualification in the field. It offers a deeper dive into the essentials of architectural practice than the Graduate Certificate. Students develop critical analysis, synthesis and problem-solving skills by tackling real-world design challenges, learn to research and apply architectural history and theory, and articulate their ideas professionally through various presentation methods. The course emphasises ethical and professional design solutions, autonomy and expert judgement, delivered through an interactive mix of studio work, research and presentations with feedback from professionals.

name: Graduate Diploma in Artificial Intelligence
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers data analytics, data visualisation, machine learning and neural networks, with hands-on AI projects. It is designed for IT and computing professionals, and for graduates from other disciplines, who want to build AI knowledge.
Study takes one year full-time and articulates into the UTS Master of Artificial Intelligence. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 42172 Introduction to Artificial Intelligence; 32555 Fundamentals of Software Development; 32130 Fundamentals of Data Analytics; 32513 Advanced Data Analytics Algorithms; 32146 Data Visualisation and Visual Analytics.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in Information Technology or Electrical and Electronic Engineering and Technology or Mathematical Sciences OR Completed Australian associate degree or advanced diploma (AQF 6), or overseas equivalent, in Information Technology.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Australian Law
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Australian Law at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is for overseas-qualified lawyers seeking to practise in New South Wales. The program is tailored to each student based on an assessment by the Legal Profession Admission Board, which is required before applying.
Students complete a minimum of 48 credit points covering contracts, torts, litigation, evidence and other core areas of Australian law. Graduates meet the academic requirements for admission as a lawyer to the NSW Supreme Court, and some also complete a practical legal training program. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Completed Bachelor of Laws or Juris Doctor from outside Australia OR be admitted to practise as a legal practitioner in a common law jurisdiction outside Australia AND evidence from the NSW Legal Profession Admission Board (LPAB) of equivalency of the applicant's legal qualification for the purpose of admission as a legal practitioner in NSW, and the list of subjects that the LPAB deems necessary for the applicant to complete to seek admission as a legal practitioner in NSW Students who have graduated with a Shari'a law qualification are not eligible to apply for this course. Assumed knowledge: Appropriately qualified knowledge of a legal system.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Business Administration
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Business Administration at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) sits between the graduate certificate and the MBA. Students complete five core MBA subjects plus electives from across UTS faculties, covering leadership, accounting, economics, marketing and finance for managers, along with strategic analysis, business planning and organisational change.
The diploma takes one year full-time and suits professionals who want more depth than a certificate without committing to the full MBA. Subjects credit towards the UTS MBA for students who choose to continue. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21880 Leading People and Change; 22800 Accounting for Managers; 23709 Economics for Management; 24834 Marketing Decision Making; 25799 Finance for Managers.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11008 Graduate Certificate in Business Administration.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Business Analytics
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Business Analytics at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is the mid-length award in the UTS business analytics sequence, sitting between the graduate certificate and the Master of Business Analytics. It covers analytics foundations, database systems, data governance and regulation, and studio subjects where students apply technical skills to practical projects, without the full research or specialisation load of the masters.

The course suits professionals from business or IT backgrounds who want more depth than a certificate in one year of full-time study. Completed subjects credit towards the UTS Master of Business Analytics. Graduates work in data analyst and business intelligence roles.
curriculum: Core subjects — 32606 Database; 22804 Business Analytics Foundations; 22805 Data Governance and Regulation; 43031 Python Programming for Data Processing; 32146 Data Visualisation and Visual Analytics.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Construction Management
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Construction Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers the work of senior construction professionals: regulation, communication, cost planning, contract management and risk. Coursework is aligned with the Project Management Body of Knowledge, and students use industry tools for cost estimating and building information modelling.
Study takes one year full-time. Students choose one disciplinary elective in areas such as real estate, asset management or entrepreneurship, and with four further subjects can progress to the UTS master's degree in the field. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 12511 Construction Technology and Regulation; 12537 Construction Management; 12591 Construction Cost Planning and Control; 12003 Time, Quality and Risk Management; 15312 Project Communication, HR and Stakeholders; 15362 Managing Project Contracts; 15310 Project Integration Management.
admission_requirements: Completed UTS Graduate Certificate in Construction Management OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent. OR A minimum of 5 years full-time or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Data Science and Innovation
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Data Science and Innovation at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is the mid-length award between the graduate certificate and the master's degree. It covers data science frameworks and models, contemporary trends, and communicating insight to varied audiences, with an emphasis on collaboration, ethical responsibility and leadership.
The course is delivered by the UTS TD School and takes one year full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any discipline with a minimum GPA of 4/7 OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any discipline AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, professional work experience in a relevant professional occupation (listed below) OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in a relevant discipline (listed below)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Engineering
description: The Graduate Diploma in Engineering at UTS is an exit-only course with no direct admission; current UTS students may apply to exit with this qualification. It is designed for professional engineers seeking to enhance their expertise and managerial skills beyond an undergraduate degree, solidifying engineering discipline knowledge while broadening understanding of engineering management. A tailored study plan reinforces the student's core engineering discipline and builds practical skills in a chosen area of specialisation, preparing graduates for engineering roles that demand advanced capabilities.

name: Graduate Diploma in Engineering Management
description: The Graduate Diploma in Engineering Management at UTS is an exit-only course with no direct admission; current UTS students may apply to exit with this qualification. It is designed for engineers and technical specialists seeking to enhance their managerial and professional engineering expertise, bridging the gap between engineering, management and leadership. Students gain an understanding of the professional, societal and environmental contexts of engineering projects, taught through seminars and collaborative project work that fosters critical thinking and problem-solving for career advancement.

name: Graduate Diploma in Environmental Engineering Management
Graduate Diploma in Event Management
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Event Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers the planning, delivery and marketing of events through subjects such as event management, principles of event marketing, event creation workshop, and events for impact and legacy. Case studies and industry input are used throughout, and content draws on UTS research in the field.
The course runs one year full-time and is aimed at people building a career in the events industry or formalising existing experience. It provides a pathway into the UTS Master of Event Management for students who want a capstone project and senior-level preparation.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21854 Creative Problem Solving; 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21930 Principles of Event Marketing; 21939 Event Creation Workshop; 21959 Events for Impact and Legacy; 21936 Event Management.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) OR Completed bachelor's degree with more than 60% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) AND a minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant post-degree professional work experience OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent AND a Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT Exam) with an overall minimum score of 550, or Graduate Record Examination (GRE General Test)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Finance
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Finance at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) comprises five core subjects and three electives, covering financial management, financial modelling and analysis, investment management, capital markets, and ethics and governance in finance. It gives students a fuller grounding in finance theory and practice than the graduate certificate.
Study takes one year full-time in central Sydney, with teaching staff drawn from industry. The diploma articulates into the UTS Master of Finance. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 25742 Financial Management; 25705 Financial Modelling and Analysis; 25721 Investment Management; 25741 Capital Markets; 25858 Ethics and Governance in Finance.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11027 Graduate Certificate in Finance.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Financial Analysis
discontinued_note: Financial analysis study at UTS now sits within the Master of Finance and Master of Quantitative Finance.

name: Graduate Diploma in Financial Planning
discontinued_note: Financial planning study at UTS now sits within the Master of Finance and its graduate certificate.

name: Graduate Diploma in Forensic Science
description: The Graduate Diploma in Forensic Science at UTS is for professional scientists seeking to enhance their forensic science expertise and leadership abilities for career progression. It integrates practical forensic disciplines with professional competencies such as project management and ethical practice. Students develop advanced scientific communication, critical thinking and the ability to manage complex projects, through theory combined with hands-on practice and case studies, preparing them for roles in law enforcement, national security and private sector investigations.

name: Graduate Diploma in Genetic Counselling
description: The Graduate Diploma in Genetic Counselling at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Genetic Counselling can apply to transfer into this course after completing 48 credit points of specified study and graduate with a graduate diploma. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Genetic Counselling provides the research and clinical training for a career as a genetic counsellor, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Diploma in Good Manufacturing Practice
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Good Manufacturing Practice at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 48 credit point course covering the regulations governing registration, manufacture, storage and supply of therapeutic goods, along with GxP and quality systems compliance. It is taught by the UTS Pharmacy discipline with SeerPharma, an industry compliance and quality assurance training provider.
Study takes one year full-time and suits professionals building a career in pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturing. The qualification is unique in the Asia-Pacific region and articulates into the UTS Master of Good Manufacturing Practice.
curriculum: Core subjects — 96057 GMP for Manufacturing Operations; 96134 Validation Principles and Practices; 96059 International GMPs and Quality Assurance; 96060 Good (Quality Control) Laboratory Practices; 96069 Contamination Control; 96062 Good Aseptic Practices and Sterile Products; 96063 GxP and Quality Auditing Practices.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience AND Communication skills, interpersonal skills, an interest in an industry where good manufacturing practices are involved, and a commitment to good manufacturing practice as a career (assessed through an interview by the faculty)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Management
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is an eight-subject course based on the UTS masters but shorter, covering human resource management, industrial relations, managing change, diversity and inclusion, and the future of work. It gives students theoretical and practical grounding in HR and employment relations.
Study takes one year full-time. Students who perform well can usually progress to the UTS Master of Human Resource Management, which carries Australian HR Institute accreditation. The diploma suits people moving into HR from another field or formalising HR experience.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21926 Managing Change; 21854 Creative Problem Solving; 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21896 Diversity and Inclusion; 21720 Human Resource Management; 21889 Future of Work.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) OR Completed bachelor's degree with more than 60% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) AND a minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant post-degree professional work experience OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent AND a Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT Exam) with an overall minimum score of 550, or Graduate Record Examination (GRE General Test)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Information Technology
description: The Graduate Diploma in Information Technology at UTS is an exit-only course with no direct admission; current UTS students may apply to exit with this qualification. It targets professionals seeking to advance their IT expertise within technical or management spheres, staying abreast of IT developments and understanding the business implications of new technologies. Students acquire advanced IT knowledge focused on application in a commercial setting, and develop skills to innovate and drive IT solutions in the workplace, through lectures, case studies and hands-on projects.
discontinued_note: This award has been replaced by the UTS Graduate Certificate in Information Technology and the Master of Information Technology.

name: Graduate Diploma in Interaction Design
description: The Graduate Diploma in Interaction Design at UTS is an exit-only course with no direct admission; current UTS students may apply to exit with this qualification. It is aimed at people transitioning into interaction design and current designers wanting to advance their skills. Students learn to create digital products that resonate with users by understanding their needs and behaviours, master iterative, human-centred design processes, tackle real-world problems, and develop solutions that fit smoothly into users' lives, honing their ability to analyse complex issues and communicate design decisions.

name: Graduate Diploma in Legal Studies
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Legal Studies at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is for non-law graduates who want a broader grounding in Australian law than the graduate certificate. Students complete three core subjects on the Australian legal system, then choose options subjects such as discrimination law, corporate governance, deceptive trade practices and public health law.
The course takes one year full-time and does not lead to admission as a lawyer. It gives professionals legal knowledge relevant to their sector and articulates into the UTS Master of Legal Studies. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 70102 Foundations of Law; 70211 Contracts; 70616 Australian Constitutional Law.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent The qualification must be in a field of study other than law or, if the qualification is in a legal field of study, it shall not be an academic qualification for legal practice. Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11264 Graduate Certificate in Legal Studies.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Management
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is an eight-subject postgraduate course covering creative problem-solving, managing change, diversity and inclusion, stewardship, and managing in a multicultural world. It is built for individuals and organisations that need postgraduate management education without the length of a full masters.
Study takes one year full-time. The course develops general management capability across strategy, people and organisational dynamics, and subjects credit towards the UTS Master of Management for students who continue.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21896 Diversity and Inclusion; 21854 Creative Problem Solving; 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21937 Managing, Leading and Stewardship; 21926 Managing Change; 21717 Managing in a Multicultural World.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) OR Completed bachelor's degree with more than 60% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) AND a minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant post-degree professional work experience OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent AND a Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT Exam) with an overall minimum score of 550, or Graduate Record Examination (GRE General Test)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Marketing
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Marketing at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a seven-subject course covering marketing management, marketing communications, brand management, customer experience and behaviour, data-driven insights, marketing for social good, and marketing strategy and leadership, plus one elective. It builds analytical and strategic marketing skills for a changing media environment.
Study is flexible, full-time or part-time across Autumn or Spring sessions, over one year full-time. The diploma articulates into the UTS Master of Marketing. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 24734 Marketing Management; 24710 Customer Experience and Behaviour; 24761 Data-Driven Insights; 24736 Marketing Communications; 24762 Marketing for Social Good; 24752 Brand Management; 24730 Marketing Strategy and Leadership.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11282 Graduate Certificate in Marketing.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Media Practice and Industry
discontinued_note: Media study at UTS now runs through the Graduate Diploma in Screen Arts and Production and related communication degrees.

name: Graduate Diploma in Medical Biotechnology
description: The Graduate Diploma in Medical Biotechnology at UTS is for professional scientists seeking skill enhancement for career progression, and for those considering research degrees. It combines sector-specific biotechnology expertise with versatile professional development, building competencies in communication, critical analysis, project management, and the ability to bring innovations to market. Learning is interactive and practical so students can apply new skills directly to work in research, science businesses, industry or government, and graduates are well prepared for roles in the private and public sectors.

name: Graduate Diploma in Pharmaceutical Sciences (Exit Only)
description: The Graduate Diploma in Pharmaceutical Sciences at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Pharmacy or Master of Pharmacy (International) can apply to transfer into this course and graduate with a graduate diploma. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Pharmacy programs provide the professional training required for registration as a pharmacist, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Diploma in Planning
description: The Graduate Diploma in Planning at UTS is for professionals in design, planning and property sectors seeking to pivot their careers, offering a comprehensive understanding of planning issues, negotiation skills and creative problem-solving. It treats planning as a critical, community-connecting task rather than a mere approval process, and property development and planning students share a foundational year. The multidisciplinary approach integrates urban design, economics and law to shape sustainable urban environments, with a strong focus on sustainability and the property development cycle, and technical skills for land market analysis, feasibility studies and evidence-based forecasting.

name: Graduate Diploma in Project Management
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Project Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is the mid-length award between the graduate certificate and the Master of Project Management. It builds disciplinary knowledge across managing risk, cost, time and stakeholders, plus capability in leadership, communication and the full project life cycle, within the UTS Faculty of Design and Society.

Study takes one year full-time. Subjects credit towards the UTS Master of Project Management. Graduates work as project managers and program coordinators across construction, IT, government, banking and consulting.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15312 Project Communication, HR and Stakeholders; 15319 Project Risk, Procurement and Quality Management; 15316 Project Scope, Time and Cost Management; 15310 Project Integration Management; 15115 Advances in Project Management; 15328 Project Innovation and Entrepreneurship.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Property Development
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Property Development at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers the full property development process across subjects in development feasibility, property development finance, valuation methodology, and planning and environmental law, plus two options subjects such as project management, urban design or capital markets.
Study takes one year full-time within the UTS Faculty of Design and Society. Graduates meet the educational requirements for Certified Property Practitioner and Certified Development Practitioner status with the Australian Property Institute, and the course maps to the RICS planning and development pathway. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15142 Property Development Process; 17700 Planning and Environmental Law; 12518 Property Transactions; 12535 Property Investment and Development Feasibility; 17771 Valuation Methodology; 17704 Property Development Finance.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11271 Graduate Certificate in Property Development.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Quantitative Finance
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Quantitative Finance at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is the shorter award in the UTS quantitative finance sequence, drawing on the same technical core as the Master of Quantitative Finance. Study covers probability and stochastic analysis, time series, optimisation and financial applications, and programming for financial data, taught in the UTS Faculty of Science.

Entry requires a quantitative undergraduate background or relevant work experience. The diploma takes one year full-time and articulates into the Master of Quantitative Finance for students who want the full specialisation. Graduates move into risk modelling, quantitative analysis and financial data roles.
curriculum: Core subjects — 68109 Advanced Communication Skills in Science; 25882 AI-powered Investment and Risk Management; 38004 Optimisation and Financial Applications; 43031 Python Programming for Data Processing; 38003 Time Series and Stochastic Calculus; 60117 Understanding Data and Statistical Design.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Science
description: The Graduate Diploma in Science at UTS is for professional scientists seeking to enhance their industry skills, and for those considering further research or education. The customisable content lets scientists in research, business, industry or government focus their studies or expand existing expertise through electives. Students develop communication, critical analysis, project management and innovation skills underpinned by a foundation in science or mathematics, applicable to careers in health, environment, finance and risk management, through lectures, practical sessions and project work.

name: Graduate Diploma in Screen Arts and Production
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Screen Arts and Production at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is an exit-only award for students in the Master of Screen Arts and Production who complete the required five subjects. It covers scripted and unscripted production and screen experience through three core studio units, plus two disciplinary electives from areas such as editing, directing, filming, producing or curation, or an industry internship.
The qualification lets students conclude their master's study early with an industry-recognised postgraduate credential. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Social Impact and Not-for-Profit Management
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Social Impact and Not-for-Profit Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is an eight-subject course covering advocacy and social change, business and social impact, fundraising and revenue, managing staff and volunteers, and legal issues for not-for-profits. It uses models and case studies to explain how the not-for-profit and social enterprise sector works.
Study takes one year full-time. The course suits people moving into management roles in charities, community organisations and social enterprises, and articulates into the UTS Master of Social Impact and Not-for-Profit Management.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21882 Legal Issues for Sports, Events and Not-for-Profits; 21854 Creative Problem Solving; 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21881 Advocacy and Social Change; 21939 Event Creation Workshop; 21778 Fundraising and Revenue Streams for Sports, Events and Not-for-Profits.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) OR Completed bachelor's degree with more than 60% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) AND a minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant post-degree professional work experience OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent AND a Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT Exam) with an overall minimum score of 550, or Graduate Record Examination (GRE General Test)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Speech and Language Sciences
description: The Graduate Diploma in Speech and Language Sciences at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Speech Pathology can apply to transfer into this course after completing 48 credit points of specified study and graduate with a graduate diploma. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Speech Pathology provides the professional training for a career as a speech pathologist, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Graduate Diploma in Sport Management
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Sport Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) combines general business literacy with sport-specific management study across subjects in sport business, sport governance and integrity, sport for social impact, and sport, events and globalisation. Case studies cover both the Australian and international sport industries.
Study takes one year full-time. The course is aimed at people building a management career in sporting organisations, clubs, federations and events, and provides a pathway into the UTS Master of Sport Management.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21854 Creative Problem Solving; 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21918 Sport Business; 21952 Sport for Social Impact; 21935 Sport, Events and Globalisation; 21920 Sport Governance and Integrity.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) OR Completed bachelor's degree with more than 60% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) AND a minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant post-degree professional work experience OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent AND a Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT Exam) with an overall minimum score of 550, or Graduate Record Examination (GRE General Test)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Strategic Communication
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Strategic Communication at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers communication planning and management, audience insights, creative appeals, ethics and sustainability, and risk, issue and crisis communication, plus two communication electives on topics such as advertising, corporate communication and media law.
Study takes one year full-time or 18 months part-time within the UTS Faculty of Design and Society. The UTS postgraduate communication degrees are reaccredited by the Public Relations Institute of Australia. Graduates work in communication, public relations and advertising roles across the public, private and non-profit sectors.
curriculum: Core subjects — 57604 Communication Theory and Practice; 57605 Foundations in Strategic Communication; 57606 Strategic Communication Planning and Management; 57607 Ethics, Responsibility and Sustainability; 57608 Finding Insights for Understanding Audiences; 57609 Creative Appeals in Advertising.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Strategic Supply Chain Management
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Strategic Supply Chain Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) extends the graduate certificate with further specialisation across seven subjects, including strategic and sustainable procurement, supply chain risk management, supply chain technology management, and operations and quality management. Assessment is research-informed and connected to industry partners.
Study takes one year full-time. The course focuses on applying current tools and management approaches to contemporary supply chain problems, and provides a pathway into the UTS Master of Strategic Supply Chain Management.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21741 Operations and Quality Management; 21877 Strategic and Sustainable Procurement Management; 21797 Strategic Supply Chain Management; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21947 Supply Chain Risk Management; 21963 Supply Chain Technology Management.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) OR Completed bachelor's degree with more than 60% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) AND a minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant post-degree professional work experience OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent AND a Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT Exam) with an overall minimum score of 550, or Graduate Record Examination (GRE General Test)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Teaching
description:
The Graduate Diploma in Teaching at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) prepares career changers and qualified teachers to teach English language, literacy and numeracy to children, post-secondary learners or adults. Five core subjects cover theories of multilingual learners and teaching methodology, and students choose a specialist stream aligned to the adult and vocational, schools, or private and overseas English teaching sectors.
Study takes two years part-time. Teaching is by research-active practitioners. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have a: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in TESOL and Applied Linguistics
description:
The Graduate Diploma in TESOL and Applied Linguistics at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) develops scholarly and practical knowledge for teaching English language and literacy to children, post-secondary learners or adults. Students complete core subjects on multilingual learners, language and teaching methodology, and choose a specialist stream by sector.
Study takes two years part-time. It sits between the graduate certificate and the master's degree in the field. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have a: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Graduate Diploma in Vision Science
description: The Graduate Diploma in Vision Science at UTS is an exit qualification: students enrolled in the Master of Orthoptics can apply to transfer into this course after completing 48 credit points of specified study and graduate with a graduate diploma. It is not available for direct admission. The parent Master of Orthoptics provides the clinical training for a career as an orthoptist, and this exit award recognises partial completion of that program.

name: Juris Doctor
description:
The Juris Doctor at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a graduate-entry law degree for people who hold a bachelor's degree in another field. Core subjects cover criminal, property, administrative and constitutional law, followed by JD electives and a legal theory subject. Study is flexible, offered by day or evening, part-time or full-time, with some subjects in weekend or intensive blocks, though it cannot be completed fully online.
The degree satisfies the academic requirements for admission as a lawyer to the Supreme Court of NSW, provided students also complete a practical legal training program. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 70102 Foundations of Law; 70114 Criminal Law and Procedure; 70311 Torts; 70211 Contracts; 70103 Ethics Law and Justice; 70104 Civil Practice; 70327 Introduction to Property and Commercial Law.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian doctorate, or overseas equivalent OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, Australian bachelor honours degree, or Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 4.5/7 OR Completed Australian graduate certificate or Australian graduate diploma, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, Australian bachelor honours degree, or Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 4.1/7.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Juris Doctor Graduate Certificate in Professional Legal Practice
description:
The Juris Doctor Graduate Certificate in Professional Legal Practice at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS), also called JD Accelerate, combines the Juris Doctor with the practical legal training needed to practise law in NSW, so graduates can be admission-ready in about three years. It is an AQF Level 9 master's degree.
Students complete the JD core stream, options and legal theory subjects, plus practical studies including a 15-day work placement. The course is accredited by the Legal Profession Admission Board and satisfies both the academic and practical legal training requirements for admission to the Supreme Court of NSW. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 70102 Foundations of Law; 70114 Criminal Law and Procedure; 70311 Torts; 70211 Contracts; 70103 Ethics Law and Justice; 70104 Civil Practice; 70327 Introduction to Property and Commercial Law.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian doctorate, or overseas equivalent OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, Australian bachelor honours degree, or Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 4.5/7 OR Completed Australian graduate certificate or Australian graduate diploma, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, Australian bachelor honours degree, or Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 4.1/7.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Juris Doctor Master of Business Administration
description:
The Juris Doctor Master of Business Administration at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a four-year combined degree covering law and business. Students take core JD subjects in areas such as business, corporate and international law alongside MBA subjects in management, economics and marketing, then specialise through JD options, a legal theory subject and a business law sub-major.
Study is flexible, by day or evening, part-time or full-time, with face-to-face and online classes. Graduates who also complete a practical legal training program are eligible for admission as a lawyer to the Supreme Court of NSW. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 70102 Foundations of Law; 70114 Criminal Law and Procedure; 70311 Torts; 70211 Contracts; 70616 Australian Constitutional Law; 70103 Ethics Law and Justice; 70104 Civil Practice 703.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian doctorate, or overseas equivalent OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, Australian bachelor honours degree, or Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 4.5/7 OR Completed Australian graduate certificate or Australian graduate diploma, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, Australian bachelor honours degree, or Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 4.1/7.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Advanced Journalism (Extension)
discontinued_note: Journalism study at UTS now runs through the Bachelor of Communication in Journalism and postgraduate communication degrees.

name: Master of Analytics (Research)
description:
The Master of Analytics (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology, work on a chosen analytics topic over multiple years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as an algorithm or portfolio.
The degree develops research and data skills for careers in analytics research and development, or as a pathway to a PhD.
curriculum: Core subjects — 31676 Thesis (Analytics); 42670 Research Foundations; 42069 Research Methods.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies. Previous qualifications must have a major in analytics, computing, applied statistics or applied mathematics. Before submitting a formal application for admission, applicants should seek the approval of a potential supervisor for their proposed research work.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Animation and Visualisation
description:
The Master of Animation and Visualisation at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a one-year accelerated degree developed with Netflix Animation Studios, formerly Animal Logic. Students choose a specialisation in 3D animation or visual effects across areas such as modelling, rigging, surfacing, effects, lighting, compositing and technical direction, and work in interdisciplinary teams to produce a studio-level 3D animated short film and a visualisation project.
The UTS Animation Academy is a Foundry education partner and a certified Houdini training centre. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 42909 The Connected Studio; 42910 The Collaboration Studio; 42911 The Challenge Studio.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study, AND advanced skills and aptitude in the nominated specialisation in 3D animation or visual effects production as demonstrated by their portfolio and work experience covered in their Curriculum Vitae (CV). Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11326 Graduate Certificate in Animation and Visualisation.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Architecture
description:
The Master of Architecture at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is the second degree in the path to registration as an architect, following an accredited bachelor's degree. Students develop advanced technical and design skills through project-based studios, choosing core Design Studios and electives aligned to their interests, with optional study tours for academic credit.
The degree is accredited by the Architects Accreditation Council of Australia. After graduating, students complete 3,300 hours of professional experience and the Architectural Practice Examination before registering with the NSW Architects Registration Board. Study takes two years full-time.
curriculum: Core subjects — 11551 Masters Architectural Design Studio 1; 11552 Masters Architectural Design Studio 2; 11553 Masters Architectural Design Studio 3.
admission_requirements: Completed within the last 8 years UTS Bachelor of Design in Architecture, UTS Bachelor of Design (Honours) in Architecture (Architectural Studies for Interior Architecture), or UTS Bachelor of Design (Honours) in Architecture (Architectural Studies for Landscape Architects)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Artificial Intelligence
description:
The Master of Artificial Intelligence at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) develops knowledge in data analytics and visualisation, machine learning and deep learning, with specialisation options in computer vision or natural language processing. It prepares students for industry projects or academic research.
The course is aimed at graduates in computing science, IT or computer engineering. Graduates are eligible to apply for Australian Computer Society professional membership. Study takes two years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 42172 Introduction to Artificial Intelligence; 32555 Fundamentals of Software Development; 32130 Fundamentals of Data Analytics; 32513 Advanced Data Analytics Algorithms; 32146 Data Visualisation and Visual Analytics; 49016 Technology and Innovation Management; 57304 The Ethics of Data and AI.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian master's or doctoral degree, or overseas equivalent, in Information Technology or Electrical and Electronic Engineering and Technology or Mathematical Sciences OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, graduate diploma, or graduate certificate, or overseas equivalent, in Information Technology or Electrical and Electronic Engineering and Technology or Mathematical Sciences with at least 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Arts (Research) (Society and Culture)
description: The Master of Arts (Research) at UTS lets students extend and deepen their knowledge through a research investigation under a supervisory panel with expertise in the proposed area. Students develop critical and analytical skills and advanced research skills for in-depth exploration of their chosen area, including for creative or professional practice, and complete three core coursework subjects to develop their research knowledge and skills. The degree is especially valuable for those pursuing an academic career, a research career or an advanced level of professional practice, including positions in the creative industries.

name: Master of Behavioural Economics
description:
The Master of Behavioural Economics at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is delivered as a mix of self-paced and face-to-face learning for professionals from any background. Students build a foundation in economic theory, then specialise in behavioural economics and its applications, learning to design and run experimental trials, weigh the ethics of behavioural interventions, and interpret data.
Study takes about 18 months full-time. Graduates apply behavioural insight in policy, product and strategy roles. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Domestic applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11299 Graduate Certificate in Behavioural Economics. Assumed knowledge: There is no assumed knowledge for the Master of Behavioural Economics.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Built Environment (Research)
description:
The Master of Built Environment (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Design, Architecture and Building, work on a chosen topic over multiple years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a portfolio or creative artefact.
The degree develops research design, analysis and communication skills for careers in architecture and construction practice, policy, and doctoral study.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Business (Research)
description:
The Master of Business (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Business School, work on a chosen business research topic, present regularly to a panel, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a portfolio or white paper.
Entry requires a recognised bachelor's degree with at least a 70 per cent average or a higher qualification, plus a pre-application expression of interest to the Business School. The degree develops research, project management and analytical skills for careers in industry, government, consulting or further doctoral study. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with 6.5 in writing.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree or an equivalent with at least a 70% average, or a higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrate potential to pursue graduate research studies. Each applicant is required, prior to application, to complete an expression of interest application with the Business School. Check the pre-application process for a research degree.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 6.5); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 64 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Business Administration
description:
The Master of Business Administration at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) develops general management capability for early-career professionals and those strengthening their business knowledge. Core subjects cover leadership, decision-making, financial management, accounting, economics and marketing, after which students choose majors, sub-majors and electives in areas such as business law, operations and supply chain, and human resource management.
Each MBA subject is reviewed by an industry board. The optional MBA Career Elevate Program adds coaching, case challenges and industry experiences. The degree takes two years full-time and is delivered flexibly. Graduates move into management and senior specialist roles across sectors.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21880 Leading People and Change; 22800 Accounting for Managers; 24834 Marketing Decision Making; 25799 Finance for Managers; 23709 Economics for Management; 21965 Organisational Change for Good.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian graduate certificate or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 5.25/7 with more than 90% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Business Analytics
description:
The Master of Business Analytics at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 72 credit point degree for professionals from business or IT backgrounds who want to work across both. Core subjects cover business analytics foundations, database systems, data governance and regulation, Python programming for data processing, and data visualisation, alongside studio subjects where students apply their skills to practical projects.
The program focuses on both the technical side of analysis and the ability to communicate insights and recommend action. It articulates from the UTS Graduate Certificate in Business Analytics. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing. Graduates work as data analysts, analytics consultants and business intelligence specialists.
curriculum: Core subjects — 32606 Database; 22804 Business Analytics Foundations; 22805 Data Governance and Regulation; 43031 Python Programming for Data Processing; 32146 Data Visualisation and Visual Analytics.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11280 Graduate Certificate in Business Analytics.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Clinical Exercise Physiology
description:
The Master of Clinical Exercise Physiology at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) trains students to use evidence-based exercise programs to prevent, treat and manage health conditions, injuries and disabilities. Study covers neurological disorders, musculoskeletal and cardiometabolic conditions, cancer, and severe mental illness, with clinical placements across the health system.
The degree is accredited by Exercise and Sports Science Australia as a qualification leading to registration as an Accredited Exercise Physiologist. Study takes about 18 months full-time. Graduates work in hospitals, rehabilitation centres and private practice. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 94911 Person-Centred Care and Self-Management; 94913 Musculoskeletal and Occupational Conditions; 94914 Neurological and Mental Health Conditions; 94921 Cardiopulmonary and Respiratory Conditions; 94922 Metabolic and Other Clinical Conditions; 94923 Oncology and Haematology Conditions.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed an Australian bachelor's degree (or higher), or an overseas equivalent, in exercise science with a minimum GPA of 5/7, and be CURRENT in one of the following Exercise and Sports Science Australia (ESSA) requirements: Accreditation as an Exercise Scientist (AES) with ESSA OR An approved or partially approved Graduate Entry Assessment from ESSA OR An approved Legacy Pathway Assessment from ESSA OR Completed a course in exercise science that is fully or provisionally accredited by ESSA.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Clinical Psychology
description:
The Master of Clinical Psychology at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) trains students for professional practice as clinical psychologists. All academic staff are practising clinical psychologists, and students develop clinical skills through the university clinic and external placements, completing 96 credit points including 24 credit points of research and 1,000 clinical hours.
