The course is accredited by the Australian Psychology Accreditation Council. Study takes two years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 96043 Introduction to Clinical Practice Skills; 96044 Child and Adolescent Clinical Psychology; 96045 Adult Clinical Psychology 1; 96046 Research Project 1; 96047 Clinical Placement 1; 96048 Adult Clinical Psychology 2; 96049 Assessment Across the Lifespan.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian Psychology Accreditation Council (APAC) accredited Level 1 and Level 2 program in psychology within the last 10 years with at least an upper second class Honours (H2A) or equivalent overall mark AND a minimum GPA of 5.8/7 AND a period of at least 6 months of relevant professional work experience in mental health. Applications and eligibility for interview are assessed based on academic performance, a period of at least 6 months of relevant professional work experience in mental health, and academic and professional references.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Cybersecurity (Extension)
description:
The Master of Cybersecurity (Extension) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) gives IT and computing professionals a practical grounding in contemporary cybersecurity, along with underpinning knowledge of computer networks, systems programming and risk management. It prepares students for industry projects or academic research.
Graduates are eligible to apply for cybersecurity professional-level membership of the Australian Computer Society. Study takes two years full-time, with lab-based teaching in the UTS Cybersecurity Precinct. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 32524 LANS and Routing; 32547 UNIX Systems Programming; 32548 Cybersecurity; 57304 The Ethics of Data and AI; 32144 Technology Research Preparation.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian master's or doctoral degree, or overseas equivalent, in Information Technology or Electrical and Electronic Engineering and Technology. OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, graduate diploma, or graduate certificate, or overseas equivalent, in Information Technology or Electrical and Electronic Engineering and Technology with at least 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included).
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Data Science and Innovation
description:
The Master of Data Science and Innovation at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is delivered by the TD School in online and face-to-face modes. The curriculum is co-designed with industry partners and regularly updated, and students work on real data sets and projects throughout, covering analytics, machine learning and the strategic use of data.
Study takes about 18 months full-time. Graduates work as data scientists, analysts and data strategists across sectors. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 36100 Data Science for Innovation; 36103 Statistical Thinking for Data Science; 36106 Machine Learning Algorithms and Applications; 36104 Data Visualisation and Narratives.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any discipline with a minimum GPA of 4/7 OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any discipline AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, professional work experience in a relevant professional occupation (listed below) OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in a relevant discipline (listed below)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Data Science in Quantitative Finance
Master of Design (Research)
description:
The Master of Design (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Design, Architecture and Building, investigate a chosen design topic over multiple years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a portfolio or creative artefact.
The degree develops research skills for design practice, education and doctoral study.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Engineering (Research)
description:
The Master of Engineering (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology, work on a chosen engineering topic over multiple years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a product or portfolio.
The degree develops research and problem-solving skills for careers in industry research and development, or as a pathway to a PhD.
curriculum: Core subjects — 49776 Master of Engineering Thesis; 42670 Research Foundations; 42069 Research Methods.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies. It is a requirement that the bachelor's degree (or equivalent) be in engineering. Before submitting a formal application for admission, applicants should seek the approval of a potential supervisor for their proposed research work.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Engineering Management
description:
The Master of Engineering Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 72 credit point degree combining coursework with an independent engineering graduate project in engineering management, taken across the final two sessions. It integrates engineering, technology and management for engineers moving into leadership roles.
Standard duration is 18 months full-time, but students with a recognised bachelor's degree may receive recognition of prior learning for up to four subjects and finish in one year. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian master's or doctoral degree, or overseas equivalent. OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, graduate diploma, or graduate certificate, or overseas equivalent, with at least 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included). Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11239 Graduate Certificate in Engineering Management.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Event Management
description:
The Master of Event Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers creating, planning, delivering and marketing events, along with analysis and evaluation skills, across subjects such as event management, principles of event marketing, and events for impact and legacy. Students finish with a research or industry project as a capstone.
Study is delivered flexibly over about 18 months full-time. The course draws on UTS teaching in the Australian events industry, from major sporting events to conferences and festivals, and prepares graduates for senior event management roles across sectors.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21854 Creative Problem Solving; 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21930 Principles of Event Marketing; 21939 Event Creation Workshop; 21959 Events for Impact and Legacy; 21936 Event Management.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C06017 Graduate Diploma in Event Management or C11038 Graduate Certificate in Event Management.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Finance
description:
The Master of Finance at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is taught in central Sydney and developed with financial institutions. Six core subjects build knowledge of financial management, financial modelling and analysis, capital markets, investment management, and ethics and governance, finishing with an applied cases capstone. Students then choose a specialisation or a spread of finance electives.
UTS is a CFA Institute University Affiliate on the basis of this degree. Study takes about 18 months full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing. Graduates work in banking, corporate finance, investment management and financial advice.
curriculum: Core subjects — 25742 Financial Management; 25705 Financial Modelling and Analysis; 25741 Capital Markets; 25721 Investment Management; 25858 Ethics and Governance in Finance; 25848 Applied Cases in Finance (Capstone).
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11027 Graduate Certificate in Finance.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Financial Analysis
discontinued_note: Financial analysis study at UTS now sits within the Master of Finance and Master of Quantitative Finance.

name: Master of Financial Planning
discontinued_note: Financial planning study at UTS now sits within the Master of Finance.

name: Master of Forensic Science (Extension)
description:
The Master of Forensic Science (Extension) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers the interpretation of forensic traces, then specialist subjects in chemical criminalistics, biometrics and forensic toxicology, plus 24 credit points of professional science subjects in communication, statistics and data. A capstone project is completed collaboratively.
Teaching is by the UTS Centre for Forensic Science, using the Super Lab and crime scene simulation facilities. Study takes two years full-time. Graduates work in public and private forensic laboratories and agencies. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 65710 Foundations of Forensic Science; 65711 Forensic Inference and Interpretation; 65712 Advanced Chemical Criminalistics; 65713 Biometrics and Identification Sciences; 65714 Forensic Toxicology and Drug Analysis; 66068 Analytical Separation Science; 65000 Master Research Capstone (Chemical and Forensic Sciences).
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in chemical sciences, biochemistry and cell biology, human biology, forensic science, or medical science Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11216 Graduate Certificate in Science.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Genetic Counselling
description:
The Master of Genetic Counselling at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) prepares students to assess genetic health risks, counsel individuals and families, and support decision-making. It is delivered mostly online, with interactive asynchronous learning, weekly live classes and a week-long on-campus block each session, plus supervised clinical placements and research training in evidence-based care.
The degree is accredited by the Human Genetics Society of Australasia. Study takes two years full-time. Graduates work as genetic counsellors in clinical genetics services, hospitals and research settings. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 96104 Communication and Counselling; 96103 Medical Genetics and Genomics in Practice; 96102 Research Methods in Genetic Counselling; 96105 Clinical and Community Placement 1; 96110 Genetic Counselling; 96108 Research Project 1; 96109 Research Issues in Genetic Counselling.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in related field of study with a minimum GPA of 4/7 AND Completed one human genetics subject (to second- or third-year undergraduate level, or equivalent)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Good Manufacturing Practice
description:
The Master of Good Manufacturing Practice at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 96 credit point degree, made up of 84 credit points of coursework and 12 credit points of research. It covers legislation on the registration, manufacture, storage and supply of therapeutic goods, quality and risk management, aseptic practice, supply chain, clinical trials, and quality assurance and control.
The course is taught with SeerPharma and is designed for professionals advancing their careers in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry. Students complete self-directed research projects, and the qualification is unique in the Asia-Pacific region.
curriculum: Core subjects — 96057 GMP for Manufacturing Operations; 96134 Validation Principles and Practices; 96059 International GMPs and Quality Assurance; 96060 Good (Quality Control) Laboratory Practices; 96061 Computer Systems Validation Principles and Practices; 96062 Good Aseptic Practices and Sterile Products; 96063 GxP and Quality Auditing Practices.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience AND Communication skills, interpersonal skills, an interest in an industry where good manufacturing practices are involved, and a commitment to good manufacturing practice as a career (assessed through an interview by the faculty)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Health Services (Research)
description:
The Master of Health Services (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Health, work on a chosen health services research topic, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a policy proposal.
The degree develops research design, analysis and communication skills for careers in health policy, health system improvement, government and further doctoral study. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 92977 Master of Health Services (Honours) Thesis; 92618 Health Care Research Methodology.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies. Applicants are required to have qualifications and experience in the health services sector. Applicants are also required to submit a research proposal and have the agreement of a suitable supervisor at the time of application.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Human Resource Management (Extension)
description:
The Master of Human Resource Management (Extension) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) runs over two years full-time. Students complete eight core subjects covering people management, industrial relations, creative problem-solving, diversity and inclusion, and the future of work, then two HR electives, then a capstone that is either an industry internship or a research project.
The degree is accredited by the Australian HR Institute, and graduates can apply for Professional Member (MAHRI) status. It suits both established HR practitioners and people entering the field, preparing them for senior roles in HR, employment relations and general management.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21854 Creative Problem Solving; 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21896 Diversity and Inclusion; 21720 Human Resource Management; 21889 Future of Work; 21702 Industrial Relations.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C07113 Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Management or C11198 Graduate Certificate in Human Resource Management.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Indigenous Health (Research)
description:
The Master of Indigenous Health (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time, focused on culturally informed research that improves Indigenous health outcomes. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Health, work on a chosen topic over multiple years, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a policy proposal or portfolio.
Graduates move into roles in Indigenous health policy, community-controlled health organisations, government and further research. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Information Technology
description:
The Master of Information Technology at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 96 credit point degree covering advanced IT concepts in a commercial context. It is made up of seven core subjects, a six-subject major, and a project and elective block, with the number of electives depending on whether students take a 6 or 12 credit point research project.
Graduates are eligible to apply for Australian Computer Society professional membership. Study takes two years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 32557 Enabling Enterprise Information Systems; 32555 Fundamentals of Software Development; 32606 Database; 32144 Technology Research Preparation; 32541 Project Management; 43030 Professional Practice in Computing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian master's or doctoral degree, or overseas equivalent. OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, graduate certificate or graduate diploma, or overseas equivalent, with at least 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included). OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, graduate certificate or graduate diploma, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant post-secondary professional work experience.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Interaction Design (Extension)
description:
The Master of Interaction Design (Extension) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) teaches an iterative, human-centred design process for solving real problems with real users. Core subjects build user experience skills, and a capstone project is co-implemented with an industry client. Students choose one of three modules: games design, data analytics or interaction programming.
Study takes two years full-time. Graduates work as interaction designers, UX designers and product designers. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 42017 Fundamentals of Interaction Design; 32509 Advanced Interaction Design; 32516 Internet Programming; 95563 Data Driven Storytelling Studio; 32405 Human-Centred Design Research Methods; 95566 Digital Experience Design Studio; 95569 Interaction Design Studio.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian master's or doctoral degree, or overseas equivalent. OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, graduate certificate, or graduate diploma, or overseas equivalent with at least 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included). Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11272 Graduate Certificate in Interaction Design. Assumed knowledge: This course does not require formal training in IT, but experience in IT would be an advantage. Some subjects require development of various impl.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of International Commercial and Business Law
description:
The Master of International Commercial and Business Law at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is open to both law and non-law professionals. Four core subjects cover contemporary business law, securities law and taxation, including consumer protection, business structures, competition law and intellectual property. Students then choose four options subjects such as contracts administration, corporate governance, and mergers and acquisitions.
Study can be completed in one year, with online and in-person classes. Graduates work in cross-border commercial, trade and advisory roles. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 79708 Contemporary Business Law; 77947 Companies and Securities Law; 77938 Introduction to Taxation Law.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian doctorate, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, Australian bachelor honours degree, or Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study with a minimum GPA of 4.5/7 OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, Australian bachelor honours degree or Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study with a minimum GPA of 3.8/7 AND Capacity to study demonstrated through a minimum of 1 year full-time or equivalent part-time relevant professional work experience.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Laws
description:
The Master of Laws at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is open only to students who already hold a law qualification. Beyond two core research subjects, students design their own program, choosing to major in one or two areas such as commercial law, intellectual property, legal practice, or law and technology, and completing a legal research project. Optional subjects range from human rights to corporate insolvency and refugee law.
Study is flexible, in person or online, day or evening, full-time or part-time, with an option for a postgraduate exchange. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian Doctoral degree in Law, or overseas equivalent (excluding a Shari’a law degree) OR Passed the Chinese Legal Professional Qualification Examination to practise law AND A minimum of 1 year full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant legal experience OR Completed Australian Master of Laws, Australian Juris Doctor, or Australian Bachelor of Laws with a minimum GPA of 5/7, or overseas equivalent (excluding a Shari’a law degree)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Learning Analytics (Research)
description:
The Master of Learning Analytics (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time, based in the UTS Connected Intelligence Centre. Students design their program with a supervisor, investigate a chosen learning analytics topic over multiple years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a policy proposal.
The degree develops research and data skills for careers in education technology, institutional research and doctoral study.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Legal Studies
description:
The Master of Legal Studies at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is for professionals who want a deeper understanding of Australian law without qualifying as a lawyer. Students complete core subjects in law foundations and areas such as administrative, constitutional and criminal law, then choose options subjects including animal law, commercial equity and environmental law.
Study is flexible, online or in person, over two years full-time or four years part-time. Graduates apply legal knowledge in policy, compliance and management roles across their industry. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 70102 Foundations of Law; 70211 Contracts; 70616 Australian Constitutional Law; 70107 Principles of Company Law.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian doctorate, or overseas equivalent OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, Australian bachelor honours degree, or Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 3.8/7 OR Completed Australian graduate certificate or Australian graduate diploma, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, Australian bachelor honours degree, or Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, with a GPA between 3.30/7 and 3.79/7.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Management (Extension)
description:
The Master of Management (Extension) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a flexible postgraduate degree for early-career professionals and recent graduates aiming at senior roles in public, private and non-profit organisations. Core and elective subjects build capability in management, leadership, problem-solving and responsible organisational stewardship, with a capstone that is either an internship or an industry research project.
Study takes two years full-time. The course develops an enterprise-wide view of building a resilient, sustainable organisation, and articulates from the UTS Graduate Certificate and Graduate Diploma in Management.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21896 Diversity and Inclusion; 21854 Creative Problem Solving; 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21937 Managing, Leading and Stewardship; 21926 Managing Change; 21717 Managing in a Multicultural World.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C07018 Graduate Diploma in Management or C11021 Graduate Certificate in Management.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Marketing (Extension)
description:
The Master of Marketing (Extension) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) runs over two years full-time. Core subjects build understanding of marketing management, communications, brand management, customer experience and behaviour, data-driven insights and marketing for social good. Students then take four marketing electives and complete a business consultancy capstone working on a real marketing challenge.
The degree emphasises digital channels, measurement and ethical, sustainability-minded practice. It articulates from the UTS Graduate Certificate in Marketing. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing. Graduates take on senior marketing roles across sectors.
curriculum: Core subjects — 24734 Marketing Management; 24710 Customer Experience and Behaviour; 24761 Data-Driven Insights; 24736 Marketing Communications; 24762 Marketing for Social Good; 24752 Brand Management; 24730 Marketing Strategy and Leadership.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11282 Graduate Certificate in Marketing.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

Master of Media Practice and Industry
discontinued_note: Media study at UTS now runs through the Master of Screen Arts and Production and related communication degrees.

name: Master of Medical Biotechnology (Extension)
description:
The Master of Medical Biotechnology (Extension) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is for graduates with a related undergraduate qualification. Core subjects cover microscopy and proteomics, alongside professional science subjects in leadership, communication and statistical design.
Study takes two years full-time in the UTS Faculty of Science. Graduates work in medical device companies, biotechnology laboratories, government agencies and research organisations. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 91573 Advanced Microscopy and Imaging; 91191 Bionanotechnology; 91574 Biotechnology and Innovation Practice; 91576 Personalised Medicine; 91575 Proteomics; 69503 Masters Research Capstone (Life Sciences); 60904 Research Translation and Clinical Trials.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in biochemistry and cell biology, microbiology, human biology, genetics, laboratory technology, medical science, food science and biotechnology, or pharmacology Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11216 Graduate Certificate in Science.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Midwifery (Research)
description:
The Master of Midwifery (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time for midwives and health professionals who want to build a research career. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Health, investigate a chosen midwifery topic over multiple years, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a policy proposal.
The degree develops research design, analysis and communication skills for careers in maternity service improvement, policy, education and doctoral study. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 92976 Master of Midwifery (Honours) Thesis; 92618 Health Care Research Methodology.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies. Applicants are required to have authorisation to practise as a registered midwife. Applicants are also required to submit a research proposal and have the agreement of a suitable supervisor at the time of application.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Nursing (Research)
description:
The Master of Nursing (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time for nurses building a research career. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Health, investigate a chosen nursing topic over multiple years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a policy proposal.
The degree develops research design, analysis and communication skills for careers in clinical research, nursing practice improvement, policy and doctoral study. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 92975 Master of Nursing (Honours) Thesis; 92618 Health Care Research Methodology.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies. Applicants are required to have authorisation to practise as a registered nurse. Applicants are also required to submit a research proposal and have the agreement of a suitable supervisor at the time of application.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Orthoptics
description:
The Master of Orthoptics at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is the only postgraduate orthoptics course in Australia. Orthoptists assess, diagnose and provide non-surgical management of eye movement disorders and vision problems in children and adults. Study covers eye anatomy and physiology, ophthalmic diagnostics, therapeutics and orthoptic clinical practice, with placements in hospitals, private practices and rehabilitation settings, including options interstate, regional and overseas.
The course is fully accredited by the Australian Orthoptic Board, and graduates are eligible for registration as an orthoptist. Study takes two years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 96027 Eye and Visual Systems; 96028 Binocular Vision and Ocular Motility 1; 96029 Ocular Pathology 1; 96030 Introduction to Professional Practice; 96031 Clinical Management of Refractive Error; 96032 Binocular Vision and Ocular Motility 2; 96033 Ocular Pathology 2.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 4/7 AND Communication skills, interpersonal skills, interest in eye health, and commitment to orthoptics as a career (assessed in an interview by the faculty)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Pharmaceutical Sciences (Research)
description:
The Master of Pharmaceutical Sciences (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time, aimed at developing more effective treatments and drug delivery. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Health, work on a chosen research topic over multiple years, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project.
Students use UTS laboratory facilities and advanced training. Graduates move into research roles in pharmaceutical companies, research institutes and doctoral study. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies. Applicants need to have completed a relevant bachelor's degree in science.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Pharmacy
description:
The Master of Pharmacy at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a two-year graduate-entry degree leading to eligibility for registration as a pharmacist. It combines therapeutics and pharmaceutical sciences with the design, delivery and evaluation of professional pharmacy services, and includes clinical placements across community and hospital settings, with a guaranteed hospital placement for eligible students.
The program is accredited by the Australian Pharmacy Council and approved by the Pharmacy Board of Australia. Graduates complete a compulsory intern training period before registration. On-campus learning uses the UTS Graduate School of Health facility. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 96015 Clinical Practice 1; 96001 Introduction to Pharmacy; 96002 Concepts in Pharmaceutical Sciences; 96003 Pharmaceutics; 96004 Professional Services 1; 96005 Professional Services 2; 96006 Integrated Therapeutics 1.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 4/7 AND Completed the following prerequisite subjects at a tertiary level within the last 10 years: one pharmacology subject two chemistry subjects one biochemistry subject one human physiology subject, and one mathematics or statistics subject AND Communication skills, interpersonal skills, interest in pharmacy, and commitment to pharmacy as a career (assessed through an interview by the faculty)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Philosophy in Forensic Science
Master of Philosophy in Medical Biotechnology
Master of Philosophy in Science
description:
The Master of Philosophy in Science at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a research degree that combines disciplinary knowledge with professional skills in project management, intellectual property and commercialisation. It has a substantial research component and develops research skills for industry or as a foundation for a research career.
The degree is supervised by academics in the UTS Faculty of Science and takes about two years full-time. It can also serve as a pathway to a PhD.
curriculum: Core subjects — 68109 Advanced Communication Skills in Science; 60117 Understanding Data and Statistical Design.
admission_requirements: This program is available to students who have completed 48 credit points in the Master of Science ( C04241 ), Master of Science (Extension) ( C04265 ), Master of Medical Biotechnology ( C04390 ), Master of Medical Biotechnology (Extension) ( C04388 ), Master of Forensic Science ( C04391 ) or Master of Forensic Science (Extension) ( C04392 )
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 6.5); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 64 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Physiotherapy (Research)
description:
The Master of Physiotherapy (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time for physiotherapists and health professionals who want to build a research career in rehabilitation and mobility. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Health, investigate a chosen topic over multiple years, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project.
The degree develops research design, analysis and communication skills for careers in clinical research, practice improvement and doctoral study. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Planning
description:
The Master of Planning at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is an in-person degree covering urban design, architecture, economics, law and ecology, and how policy, environmental and demographic frameworks shape urban decisions. Students complete a minor or major planning project in their final year.
The degree is accredited by the Planning Institute of Australia, giving a nationally recognised qualification. Study takes 18 months full-time or three years part-time. Graduates work in local and state government planning, private consultancies and property development.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15142 Property Development Process; 15146 Sustainable Urban Development; 17700 Planning and Environmental Law; 15222 Urban Design; 15251 Spatial Analysis in Planning and Property; 15145 Development Negotiation and Community Engagement.
admission_requirements: Completed UTS Bachelor of Property Economics OR Completed UTS Graduate Certificate or UTS Graduate Diploma in Planning, Property and Planning, Property Development, or Urban Planning/Urban Design with a minimum GPA of 5/7 OR Completed Australian bachelor's, bachelor honours degree, or master's degree, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study OR Completed Australian Graduate Certificate or Graduate Diploma, or overseas equivalent, in a related field of study with a minimum GPA of 5/7 AND A minimum of 3 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Professional Accounting
description:
The Master of Professional Accounting at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is designed for graduates from non-accounting disciplines who want to enter the profession. Core subjects cover management accounting, financial reporting and analysis, corporate accounting, taxation, business law, economics and financial management, developing the practical skills used in accounting roles.
The course meets the education requirements for membership of CPA Australia, Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand, CIMA and the Institute of Public Accountants, and gives exemptions towards ACCA membership. Study takes about 18 months full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 22747 Accounting for Managerial Decisions; 25742 Financial Management; 79708 Contemporary Business Law; 23706 Economics for Management; 22748 Financial Reporting and Analysis; 22753 Cost Management and Analysis; 22754 Corporate Accounting.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in a field of study other than Accounting with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11206 Graduate Certificate in Professional Accounting.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Professional Engineering
description:
The Master of Professional Engineering at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is an accredited graduate-entry engineering qualification. It combines professional engineering subjects, major-specific subjects, an independent project taken across the final three sessions, and an engineering practice stream, plus two electives.
The majors in Biomedical, Civil, Cybersecurity and Mechanical Engineering are accredited by Engineers Australia at Professional Engineer level and recognised internationally under the Washington Accord. Study takes about two years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
curriculum: Core subjects — 42203 Sustainable Engineering Design; 41055 Professional Experience Review; 41035 Professional Practice Preparation 1.
admission_requirements: qualifications in Engineering or Computer Science in an area relevant to the proposed major: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or overseas equivalent, in Engineering at the Engineering technologist level or below, or Computer Science with at least 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included).
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Project Management
description:
The Master of Project Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) builds disciplinary knowledge across managing risk, cost, time and stakeholders, plus job-ready capability in leadership, communication and innovation. From a core foundation, students choose electives and a path that fits their sector, and the degree sits within the UTS Faculty of Design and Society.
Study takes about 18 months full-time. Graduates work as project managers, program coordinators and PMO staff across construction, IT, government, banking, events and consulting. The course builds on the UTS Graduate Certificate and Graduate Diploma in Project Management.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15312 Project Communication, HR and Stakeholders; 15319 Project Risk, Procurement and Quality Management; 15316 Project Scope, Time and Cost Management; 15310 Project Integration Management; 15115 Advances in Project Management; 15328 Project Innovation and Entrepreneurship; 15346 Organisational Project Management.
admission_requirements: Completed UTS Graduate Certificate in Project Management, UTS Graduate Diploma in Project Management, or UTS Graduate Diploma in Construction Management OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent AND A minimum of 1 year full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11005 Graduate Certificate in Project Management.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Property Development
description:
The Master of Property Development at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers the full development cycle: the development process, transactions, valuation, risk analysis, property markets and large-scale development. Students choose a sub-major in property valuation or urban planning, or a set of options subjects, and complete a group project planning an urban renewal site.
Graduates who complete the valuation sub-major meet the education requirements for Certified Practising Valuer status, and for Certified Property Practitioner and Certified Development Practitioner status, with the Australian Property Institute. Study takes 18 months full-time.
curriculum: Core subjects — 12511 Construction Technology and Regulation; 15142 Property Development Process; 17700 Planning and Environmental Law; 12518 Property Transactions; 12535 Property Investment and Development Feasibility; 17771 Valuation Methodology.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in Architecture and Building, Engineering, Management and Commerce, Law and legal studies, or Economics and Econometrics OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Property Development and Investment
description:
The Master of Property Development and Investment at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a dual-discipline degree for property and real estate professionals. First-year subjects cover property transactions, capital markets and real estate economics; second-year subjects add portfolio and asset management, valuation, law and risk analysis, with options subjects in areas such as complex projects, urban design and construction management.
Graduates who complete the valuation sub-major meet the education requirements for Certified Practising Valuer status with the Australian Property Institute. Study takes two years full-time.
curriculum: Core subjects — 12511 Construction Technology and Regulation; 15142 Property Development Process; 12535 Property Investment and Development Feasibility; 17700 Planning and Environmental Law; 12518 Property Transactions; 17551 Property Market and Risk Analysis; 17771 Valuation Methodology.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in Architecture and Building, Engineering, Management and Commerce, Law, Economics and Econometrics, Real Estate, or Finance OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Property Development and Planning
description:
The Master of Property Development and Planning at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a dual-discipline degree covering how urban economies work, how design and sustainability principles are applied, and how development feasibility is assessed. Core subjects include planning and environmental law, urban design, finance and economics, spatial analysis, sustainable development, and property development and investment, finishing with a major or minor project.
The degree is accredited by the Planning Institute of Australia. It is designed for property and planning professionals and graduates in related fields. Study takes two years full-time.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15142 Property Development Process; 12535 Property Investment and Development Feasibility; 15146 Sustainable Urban Development; 17700 Planning and Environmental Law; 12518 Property Transactions; 17551 Property Market and Risk Analysis; 15222 Urban Design.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's, bachelor honours degree, or master's degree, or overseas equivalent OR Completed UTS Graduate Certificate or UTS Graduate Diploma in Property Development, UTS Graduate Certificate or UTS Graduate Diploma in Planning, UTS Graduate Certificate or UTS Graduate Diploma in Property and Planning, or UTS Graduate Certificate or UTS Graduate Diploma in Urban Planning (online) or UTS Graduate Certificate or UTS Graduate Diploma in Urban Planning and Design (online) or UTS Graduate Certificate or UTS Graduate Diploma in Urban Design (online)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Property Development and Project Management
description:
The Master of Property Development and Project Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) combines property development knowledge with project management practice. Core subjects cover the development process, valuation, transactions, finance and risk analysis alongside project integration, procurement, quality management and leadership, and students complete a group project on a real development challenge.
The course is accredited by the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors and by the Project Management Institute's Global Accreditation Center. Study takes two years full-time. Graduates work across property, construction and project management.
curriculum: Core subjects — 15142 Property Development Process; 12535 Property Investment and Development Feasibility; 17771 Valuation Methodology; 17700 Planning and Environmental Law; 12518 Property Transactions; 17551 Property Market and Risk Analysis; 17704 Property Development Finance.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in Architecture and Building, Engineering, Management and Commerce, Law, or Economics and Econometrics OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study AND A minimum of 1 year full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C11005 Graduate Certificate in Project Management.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Quantitative Finance
description:
The Master of Quantitative Finance at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a nine-subject technical degree covering probability and stochastic analysis, time series, optimisation and financial applications, Python programming for data processing, and AI-powered investment and risk management. It is taught in the UTS Faculty of Science alongside the mathematics and computing schools.
Entry requires a quantitative undergraduate degree or equivalent workplace experience. Study takes about 18 months full-time. Graduates work in quantitative analysis, risk modelling, algorithmic trading and financial data science roles in banks, funds and financial technology firms.
curriculum: Core subjects — 68109 Advanced Communication Skills in Science; 25882 AI-powered Investment and Risk Management; 38004 Optimisation and Financial Applications; 43031 Python Programming for Data Processing; 38003 Time Series and Stochastic Calculus; 60117 Understanding Data and Statistical Design; 38007 Financial Market Instruments.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in mathematical sciences, mathematical finance, insurance and actuarial studies, or a related field of study with a substantial quantitative component for example, physics and astronomy, engineering and related technology, computer science, banking, finance, and economics and econometrics.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Real Estate Investment
description:
The Master of Real Estate Investment at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) covers asset and portfolio management, investment property valuation, real estate economics, real estate equities, capital markets and property transactions, plus an options elective in areas such as financial modelling. It is designed for real estate professionals and people in related fields who want to move into investment work.
Study takes 18 months full-time or three years part-time, with flexible delivery. The course sits within the UTS Faculty of Design and Society and prepares graduates for roles in property funds, investment analysis, asset management and valuation.
curriculum: Core subjects — 17779 Investment Asset Portfolio Management; 12535 Property Investment and Development Feasibility; 17556 Investment Property Valuation; 17772 Real Estate Economics; 17777 Real Estate Equities; 12518 Property Transactions; 12515 Strategic Asset Management.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or Australian bachelor honours degree, or overseas equivalent, in Real Estate, Valuation, Building Construction Economics, Engineering, Business Management, Finance, or Management and Commerce OR Completed Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, in Property or Real Estate, Business, Finance, Valuation and Commerce, or Economics OR Completed UTS Graduate Certificate or UTS Graduate Diploma in Property Development OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Science (Research)
description:
The Master of Science (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Science, work on a chosen science topic over multiple years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as an algorithm or venture.
The degree develops research and problem-solving skills for industry research and development, or as a pathway to a PhD.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Science in Computing Sciences (Research)
description: The Master of Science (Research) in Computing Sciences at UTS enables graduates to extend and deepen their knowledge in a specialised area of computing by undertaking research under the supervision of an academic staff member. It offers flexibility in the choice of research topic so it can align closely with a student's professional career, and prepares graduates for positions in universities and other research institutions, including teaching, and for research and development roles with national and international firms.

name: Master of Science in Mathematical Sciences (Research)
description: The Master of Science (Research) in Mathematical Sciences at UTS provides an opportunity to acquire research skills and deepen knowledge in an area of mathematics. The aim is the professional development of candidates through mastery of a substantial body of mathematical literature together with original research work under a supervisor. Skills in research and mathematical thinking are in growing demand in industry, finance and government, and the research topic can be chosen to support career paths such as senior market research, quantitative management and quantitative finance.

name: Master of Screen Arts and Production
description:
The Master of Screen Arts and Production at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a practice-focused degree taught in a studio-based environment by industry professionals. Students work in scripted and unscripted formats, develop a professional portfolio, choose electives in areas such as camera systems, media editing and production, and complete a self-designed short screen project.
Study takes about 18 months full-time. Graduates work as multi-skilled screen practitioners in film, television and online content. English requirements are IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in Society and Culture or Creative Arts OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent in any field of study AND A minimum of 2 years full-time, or equivalent part-time, relevant professional work experience in the screen industry AND an interest in the course and demonstrated understanding of the opportunities present in Screen Arts and Production.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Social Impact and Not-for-Profit Management
description:
The Master of Social Impact and Not-for-Profit Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is the longest-running degree of its kind in Australia and offers a limited number of Commonwealth Supported Places. Subjects cover social change, advocacy, creative problem-solving, legal considerations, fundraising and people management, with practical assessments based on real sector challenges and input from industry guest speakers.
Study takes about 18 months full-time. The degree prepares graduates to lead charities, community organisations and social enterprises, and builds on the UTS Graduate Diploma in the same field.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21896 Diversity and Inclusion; 21854 Creative Problem Solving; 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21881 Advocacy and Social Change; 21939 Event Creation Workshop; 21778 Fundraising and Revenue Streams for Sports, Events and Not-for-Profits.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C07019 Graduate Diploma in Social Impact and Not-for-Profit Management or C11024 Graduate Certificate in Social Impact and Not-for-Profit Management.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Speech and Language Sciences (Research)
description:
The Master of Speech and Language Sciences (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time, focused on understanding and treating speech and language disorders. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Health, work on a chosen topic over multiple years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a portfolio of work.
Graduates move into clinical research, practice improvement and doctoral study. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Speech Pathology
description:
The Master of Speech Pathology at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a two-year graduate-entry degree preparing students to assess, diagnose, treat and manage communication and swallowing disorders across the lifespan. It combines coursework with extensive clinical placements and covers inclusive practice, telepractice, e-health records, generative AI in therapy, and practice management.
The program is accredited by Speech Pathology Australia, and graduates are qualified to practise as speech pathologists in Australia. Work is available across the health, education and disability sectors. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 96115 Evidence-based Practice in Speech Pathology; 96116 Fundamentals in Speech Pathology; 96117 Speech Sound Disorders in Children; 96118 Language Disorders in Children; 96119 Research Design in Speech Pathology; 96120 Augmentative and Alternative Communication; 96121 Motor Speech Disorders.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with a minimum GPA of 4.75/7 AND Communication skills, interpersonal skills, interest in speech pathology, and commitment to speech pathology as a career (assessed through an interview) AND For applicants with a speech pathology/speech therapy degree completed overseas, demonstrated motivation for repeating a speech pathology qualification (assessed through a personal statement)
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Sport and Exercise (Research)
description:
The Master of Sport and Exercise (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time, focused on athletic performance and health. Students design their program with a supervisor and the UTS Faculty of Health, investigate a chosen sport or exercise science topic over multiple years, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project.
Students work in UTS exercise laboratories with access to advanced training. Graduates move into research roles in high-performance sport, sports science and doctoral study. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
curriculum: Core subjects — 92052 Master of Sport and Exercise Thesis; 92054 Research and Statistics for Sport and Exercise.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies. The bachelor's degree must be in a related field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Sport Management
description:
The Master of Sport Management at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) develops business and leadership skills for the sport industry across subjects in sport business, sport governance and integrity, sport for social impact, and sport, events and globalisation. Teaching covers sponsorship and endorsement, competition integrity, event management and social responsibility in local, national and international contexts.
Study takes about 18 months full-time. UTS is a major provider of sport management education in Sydney, and graduates move into management roles in sporting organisations, leagues, clubs and events.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21854 Creative Problem Solving; 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21918 Sport Business; 21952 Sport for Social Impact; 21935 Sport, Events and Globalisation; 21920 Sport Governance and Integrity.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree or higher qualification, or overseas equivalent, with more than 75% of all subjects completed at pass level (conceded pass not included) Applicants who do not meet the criteria above should consider applying for C07029 Graduate Diploma in Sport Management or C11037 Graduate Certificate in Sport Management.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Strategic Communication
description:
The Master of Strategic Communication at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a practice-oriented degree covering communication theory and practice, strategic communication planning and management, audience insights, ethics and sustainability, and risk, issue and crisis communication. Students then choose four Strategic Communication electives in areas such as corporate marketing communication and creativity.
Study takes 18 months full-time or three years part-time within the UTS Faculty of Design and Society. Graduates work in communication and public relations roles across government, corporate and not-for-profit organisations.
curriculum: Core subjects — 57604 Communication Theory and Practice; 57605 Foundations in Strategic Communication; 57606 Strategic Communication Planning and Management; 57607 Ethics, Responsibility and Sustainability; 57608 Finding Insights for Understanding Audiences; 57609 Creative Appeals in Advertising; 57610 Risk, Issue and Crisis Communication.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian master’s degree, Australian graduate certificate, or Australian graduate diploma, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or overseas equivalent, in Management and Commerce, Society and Culture, or Creative Arts OR Completed Australian bachelor's degree, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Strategic Supply Chain Management (Extension)
description:
The Master of Strategic Supply Chain Management (Extension) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) develops advanced capability in identifying and deploying new technologies, managing risk, analysing data and delivering improvements across complex supply chains. Core subjects cover strategic supply chain management, sustainable procurement, supply chain risk, and operations and quality management, with an emphasis on responsible and socially conscious practice.
Study takes two years full-time. The course builds on the UTS Graduate Certificate and Graduate Diploma in the same field, and prepares graduates for management roles in procurement, logistics and operations across sectors.
curriculum: Core subjects — 21895 Business and Social Impact; 21741 Operations and Quality Management; 21877 Strategic and Sustainable Procurement Management; 21797 Strategic Supply Chain Management; 21928 Managing Staff and Volunteers; 21947 Supply Chain Risk Management; 21963 Supply Chain Technology Management.

english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Sustainable Futures (Research)
description:
The Master of Sustainable Futures (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree of about two years full-time, based in the UTS Institute for Sustainable Futures. Students design their program with a supervisor, investigate a chosen sustainability topic over multiple years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a policy proposal or portfolio.
The degree develops research and analysis skills for careers in sustainability policy, consulting, government and further doctoral study.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies. Previous qualifications must be in a relevant field. Applications to the Institute for Sustainable Futures are assessed based on the following four criteria: professional experience - strength and relevance to the candidate's opportunities (impact) research output (quality and impact) research proposal (quality) academic merit (quality).
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 64 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Teaching in Primary Education
description:
The Master of Teaching in Primary Education at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a graduate-entry initial teacher education degree. Students complete 30 credit points of core primary education subjects covering inclusive education, Indigenous knowledges, literacy, numeracy, digital learning and classroom management, plus 48 credit points across the Key Learning Areas, and professional experience in partner schools.
The course is accredited by the NSW Education Standards Authority as a primary teaching qualification. Study takes two years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.5 overall, in line with NESA teacher standards.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, bachelor's (honours), master's degree or doctorate, or overseas equivalent AND A minimum of 1 year full-time, or equivalent part-time, study (normally 8 units of study) that is relevant to one or more Key Learning Areas of the primary school curriculum (this is a prerequisite requirement from the NSW Education Standards Authority (NESA) Students who have studied overseas may be required to meet additional requirements set by the NSW Education Standards Authority (NESA) in order to qualify as teachers in NSW.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.5 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Teaching in Secondary Education
description:
The Master of Teaching in Secondary Education at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a 96 credit point graduate-entry teacher education degree. Students complete 42 credit points of core subjects covering Indigenous knowledges, inclusive education, digital teaching and adolescent learners, then specialise in a single teaching area such as English, Science, Maths or HSIE, or a combined specialisation, with professional experience in partner schools.
The course is accredited by the NSW Education Standards Authority as a secondary teaching qualification. Study takes two years full-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.5 overall, in line with NESA teacher standards.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian bachelor's degree, bachelor's honours, master's degree, doctorate, or overseas equivalent, with at least one major discipline study relevant to the teaching area, as described by the NSW curriculum and consistent with NESA Subject Content Knowledge Requirements Students who have studied overseas may be required to meet additional requirements set by the NSW Education Standards Authority (NESA) to qualify as teachers in NSW.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 7.5 (writing 7.0); TOEFL iBT 94 (writing 24); PTE Academic 65 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of TESOL and Applied Linguistics
description:
The Master of TESOL and Applied Linguistics at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) develops advanced knowledge for teaching English language and literacy to children, post-secondary learners or adults. Six core subjects cover multilingual learners, language and teaching methodology, informed by current research, and students choose a specialist stream aligned to the sector they want to work in.
Study takes 18 months full-time or three years part-time. English requirements are IELTS Academic 7.0 overall.
admission_requirements: Completed Australian master's degree, or overseas equivalent, in any field of study.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Master of Transdisciplinary Innovation (Research)
description:
The Master of Transdisciplinary Innovation (Research) at the University of Technology Sydney (UTS) is a supervised research degree based in the UTS TD School. Students design their program with a supervisor, investigate a real-world challenge across disciplines over about two years, present to expert panels, and submit a thesis or a practice-led project such as a portfolio or creative artefact.
The degree develops research, systems thinking and collaboration skills for innovation roles across industry, government and non-profits, or a pathway to a PhD.
admission_requirements: Applicants must have completed a UTS recognised bachelor's degree, or an equivalent or higher qualification, or submitted other evidence of general and professional qualifications that demonstrates potential to pursue graduate research studies.
english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (writing 6.0); TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21); PTE Academic 58 (writing 50). UTS also accepts its UTS College academic English courses.

name: Bachelor of Behavioural Science (Psychology)
description:
