name: Bachelor of Information Technology
description:
A three-year degree taught entirely in VU's block format, so students take one IT subject at a time for four weeks before moving to the next, rather than the usual four-subjects-at-once semester grind. VU has published its own research on this model and reports pass rates climbing from 77% to nearly 87% after it was introduced, which the university leans on heavily in how it markets the course to first-in-family students who might otherwise struggle with a traditional course load.

Students choose a major partway through (options typically include software development, cybersecurity, networking or data analytics), and the degree includes an industry-based learning placement in the final year, giving graduates workplace experience before they finish. VU's IT program has a large international cohort, and the block structure was partly designed with exactly that group in mind: intensive, single-subject study is easier to follow for students still building English academic fluency than four simultaneous subjects.

Graduates commonly go into junior developer, systems administrator or support analyst roles across Melbourne's west, an area VU has deliberately positioned itself to serve given its Footscray and Sunshine campus locations sit closer to industrial and logistics employers than the CBD-focused universities.
curriculum:
Year 1: Programming Fundamentals, Web Development, Database Design, Networking Essentials
Year 2: Data Structures and Algorithms, Systems Analysis, Cybersecurity Principles, Major elective units begin
Year 3: Advanced major units (Software Development, Networking, or Data Analytics stream), Industry-Based Learning placement, IT Capstone Project
admission_requirements: ATAR 60 or equivalent, VU Block Model entry
english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Laws
description:
VU's law degree requires 384 credit points across four years: 96 points of first-year core study, 132 points of professional core law units (the ones needed for admission), 108 points of law electives and 48 points of non-law electives, and is taught out of VU's City campus, which the university markets as sitting inside Melbourne's legal precinct near the courts and major firms.

Students who perform strongly early (a distinction average across the first 192 credit points) can apply to transfer into the honours version of the degree, assessed against their top 12 law units, so the honours distinction isn't set from day one the way it is at some universities. It's earned partway through. Core areas covered are the ones required for admission to legal practice everywhere in Australia: contracts, torts, property, constitutional, criminal and corporate law.

Because VU draws heavily from Melbourne's west, a lot of the clinical and community legal placement options connect students with legal aid and community legal centres in that catchment rather than corporate firm internships, which shapes the kind of practical legal experience students tend to graduate with.
curriculum:
Year 1: Introduction to Law, Contracts, Torts, Legal Research and Writing
Year 2: Criminal Law, Property Law, Constitutional Law, Law elective
Year 3: Corporate Law, Administrative Law, Evidence, Law electives
Year 4: Professional Responsibility, Advanced law electives, Non-law electives, Clinical Legal Practice option
admission_requirements: ATAR 70 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Nursing
description:
VU's nursing degree runs out of the St Albans campus and requires 288 credit points of core study plus roughly 800 hours of clinical placement and around 140 hours of simulation training at the Sunshine Clinical School, which sits alongside a working hospital precinct in Melbourne's west. The clinical simulation load is concentrated in third year, after students have built up foundational anatomy, physiology and nursing practice units in years one and two.

The course leads to registration eligibility with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia, and VU's placement partnerships lean on the public hospitals across Melbourne's western and northern suburbs, with Western Health and its network featuring heavily, rather than a spread across the whole city, which means graduates often end up working close to where they trained.

A combined Bachelor of Midwifery/Bachelor of Nursing pathway also exists at VU for students who know from the outset they want registration in both areas, though the standalone nursing degree is the more common entry point.
curriculum:
Year 1: Anatomy and Physiology, Foundations of Nursing Practice, Health Assessment, Pharmacology Basics
Year 2: Medical-Surgical Nursing, Mental Health Nursing, Clinical Placement Block 1
Year 3: Complex Care Nursing, Simulation-based clinical training (Sunshine Clinical School), Clinical Placement Blocks 2 and 3
Year 4: Specialty placements (paediatrics, aged care, community health), Transition to Professional Practice, Capstone
admission_requirements: ATAR 65 or equivalent, National Police Check and Working with Children Check required
english_requirements: IELTS 7.0 (no band below 7.0)

name: Bachelor of Outdoor Leadership
description: The Bachelor of Outdoor Leadership at Victoria University is designed to meet the needs of the outdoor education and recreation sectors. Students apply on-campus study through activities in VU's outdoor labs, combining knowledge of the natural environment, group leadership and planning to open career possibilities in adventure tourism, environmental education, outdoor recreation and nature tourism. The course includes a paid internship with The Outdoor Education Group designed to run alongside study, and explores its themes through adventure-based activities such as bushwalking, canoeing, cycling, white-water rafting, alpine activities and rock climbing.

name: Bachelor of Paramedicine
description: The Bachelor of Paramedicine at Victoria University develops the skills to work as a registered paramedic in ambulance, primary healthcare and community healthcare settings. While studying, students are registered with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency. Students study paramedicine theory in the classroom and put it into practice in high-fidelity simulation clinics, clinical-practice labs and during work-integrated learning, working with experienced registered health professionals and academics to graduate confident and job-ready. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Physical Education and Sport Science
description: The Bachelor of Physical Education and Sport Science at Victoria University covers subjects across games and sports, skill acquisition and motor development, inclusive physical activity, anatomy, kinesiology, health and nutrition, exercise physiology and biomechanics, and individual fitness activities, aquatics and athletics. Students can expand their career options with a minor in another discipline, and access to strong industry partners means graduates are ready to progress a career in the sport industry or continue to further study. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Psychological Science
description:
An APAC-accredited undergraduate psychology sequence, which matters because it's the accreditation students need if they want to progress to honours and eventually provisional registration as a psychologist. A non-accredited psych degree closes that path off entirely. VU delivers the core sequence (research methods, cognition, developmental, social and biological psychology, and statistics) in its block format, meaning students spend four weeks immersed in, say, statistics before moving to the next unit rather than splitting attention across a semester.

Students needing the accredited sequence typically go on to VU's honours year or transfer into postgraduate psychology elsewhere, since the three-year bachelor alone isn't sufficient for registration. The course also serves students who don't intend to become psychologists at all: human resources, market research and community services graduates make up a meaningful share of the cohort, using the degree as a behavioural-science foundation rather than a clinical pathway.

VU's psych program is smaller than the large metropolitan universities' offerings, which in practice means smaller tutorial groups in the statistics and research methods units that trip a lot of students up elsewhere.
curriculum:
Year 1: Introduction to Psychology, Biological Psychology, Statistics for Psychology, Research Methods 1
Year 2: Cognitive Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Social Psychology, Research Methods 2
Year 3: Abnormal Psychology, Psychological Assessment, Research Methods 3, Applied Psychology electives
admission_requirements: ATAR 60 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Psychology (Honours)
description: The Bachelor of Psychology (Honours) at Victoria University covers human behaviour, motivation and relationships and prepares students to apply for registration as a provisional psychologist and to take up further study options. The first three years focus on psychology and social research methods, including a work placement in the third year, and the fourth honours year covers advanced quantitative and qualitative research methods, professional practice units and a research thesis. Graduates have an in-depth knowledge of human emotion and behaviour. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Science (Honours) (Biomedical Science)
description: The Bachelor of Science (Honours) at Victoria University builds on a bachelor degree with a fourth year focused on a specialist research thesis, in areas including biomedicine, environmental sciences, food sciences, nursing, midwifery, sport science and exercise science. The honours year develops skills in independent research, critical analysis, problem solving, and devising, designing and conducting experimental work, along with written and spoken communication and research ethics, and prepares graduates for postgraduate research and a competitive job market.

name: Bachelor of Screen Media
description: The Bachelor of Screen Media at Victoria University develops skills in using media to tell stories across film, television, radio, screen culture, and online and mobile media production. Through practical and theoretical learning, students develop new media production skills, techniques and knowledge, including intellectual property, with a contemporary focus on delivering content for online distribution, video-on-demand and streaming platforms as well as television and radio. Students learn from teachers involved in the industry and produce cross-platform projects, motion graphics and visual effects, narrative and non-fiction film, documentaries, podcasts, and television and radio programs. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Social Work
description:
A four-year professionally accredited degree (Australian Association of Social Workers accreditation applies) that trains students for statutory and community-sector practice across Melbourne's west, a region with some of the highest need for social services in the state. VU built the course around two substantial field placements (typically around 1,000 hours combined across the degree), placing students in child protection, community health, mental health and family services settings rather than leaving fieldwork to a single capstone block.

Like the rest of VU's course offering, theory units run block-mode, one subject over four weeks, though placement blocks necessarily run on the employer's schedule rather than the university's. The curriculum spends real time on Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander social work perspectives and on Melbourne's west specifically as a case study in structural disadvantage, which reflects VU's own catchment: a large share of its students come from the same low-SES postcodes the degree is training them to work in.

Graduates go on to registration-eligible roles in child and family services, community mental health and case management, with VU's local reputation among Melbourne's west community organisations doing a lot of the placement-to-job pipeline work.
curriculum:
Year 1: Introduction to Social Work, Human Development, Sociology for Practice, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Perspectives
Year 2: Social Work Theory and Methods, Field Placement 1, Mental Health and Wellbeing
Year 3: Social Policy, Community Development, Field Placement 2
Year 4: Advanced Practice Methods, Research Project, Professional Ethics and Law
admission_requirements: ATAR 60 or equivalent, National Police Check required
english_requirements: IELTS 7.0 (no band below 7.0)

name: Bachelor of Sport Management
description: The Bachelor of Sport Management at Victoria University teaches management techniques and their application to the sport and physical recreation industries, including planning, human resource management, finance, leadership, marketing and performance evaluation. Graduates are prepared to manage professional sport organisations, major sporting events and facilities, as well as community sport programs, social development projects, outdoor adventure activities and active recreation. VU is a leading sport university, and classroom activities are blended with online and practical learning, including work placements. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Bachelor of Sport Science
description:
This is where VU's biggest research reputation actually lives: the university's Institute for Health and Sport was ranked #6 in the world for sport science by ShanghaiRanking in 2025, and undergraduates in this course get taught out of the same $68 million exercise physiology, biomechanics and motor-learning facility at Footscray Park that the institute's 100-plus researchers and postgrad cohort use.

Students work through core units in exercise physiology, biomechanics, motor learning and skill acquisition before specialising toward strength and conditioning, clinical exercise or high-performance sport pathways, and the degree includes practical placement hours with sporting organisations. VU has longstanding research partnerships with elite clubs that occasionally translate into student placement opportunities, though those aren't guaranteed for everyone.

Compared to sport science programs that lean heavily on classroom theory, VU's course puts students in the lab early: first-year students are running basic physiological testing protocols rather than only reading about them, which is a deliberate consequence of the block model letting each subject go deep on one topic without competing for lab time against three other units.
curriculum:
Year 1: Human Anatomy, Exercise Physiology Fundamentals, Functional Anatomy, Introduction to Biomechanics
Year 2: Motor Learning and Skill Acquisition, Strength and Conditioning Principles, Research Methods, Nutrition for Performance
Year 3: Specialisation units (Clinical Exercise, High Performance Sport, or Strength and Conditioning), Practicum Placement, Sport Science Capstone Project
admission_requirements: ATAR 55 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Youth Work
description: The Bachelor of Youth Work at Victoria University teaches students to help young people develop resilience through activities that are enjoyable, challenging and educational. Graduates gain a professional foundation for working with young people, specialist knowledge to support disadvantaged groups, and practical management and leadership skills. VU's program is the largest of its kind in Australia and is delivered by youth-work specialists, sociologists and experienced workers from disability, legal care, community development and social work. Students undertake substantial professional work placements. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Beauty Therapy
description: The Diploma of Beauty Therapy (SHB50121) at Victoria University TAFE advances beauty-treatment skills and prepares students for management positions in salons and spas. Students develop knowledge of the theory and science behind beauty treatments and gain extensive hands-on experience, including a practical placement in a salon of their choice and learning in VU's beauty salon. Training covers facial treatments, lash and brow treatments, manicures and pedicures, make-up, waxing, body massage and treatments, spa treatments, and retail skin care and cosmetics, along with business and management skills for running a salon.

name: Diploma of Building and Construction (Building)
description: The Diploma of Building and Construction (Building) (CPC50220) at Victoria University prepares students to work as building project managers and to run a construction business in the residential, industrial or commercial sectors. Learning is linked to real-world practice, from industry-standard knowledge to on-site projects, and covers quantity surveying, planning and scheduling of labour and materials, selecting contractors, managing project risk and quality, supervising work sites, construction technology, workplace safety, business codes and standards, structural principles, interpreting plans and specifications, and small business finance. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Business (Enterprise)
description: The Diploma of Business (Enterprise) at Victoria University prepares students for university study in the Bachelor of Business or for an entry-level business role. It provides a broad introduction to the industry and foundation skills relevant to working in the business sector, including accounting, management, marketing, economics, communications and information technology. Students who complete the diploma can articulate into the first or second year of a related VU bachelor degree with credit. It is offered at VU in Melbourne, and is also suited to students who want a shorter standalone business qualification.

name: Diploma of Criminal Justice and Psychological Studies
Diploma of Cyber Security
description: The Diploma of Cyber Security at Victoria University provides the foundational skills and knowledge to identify, prevent and respond to cyber threats, with hands-on experience in security technologies and practices including ethical hacking, digital forensics, network security, threat analysis, vulnerability assessment and incident response. Graduates are prepared for secure, entry-level roles, and completing the diploma provides a pathway into VU's related bachelor degrees. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.
curriculum: Introduction to Programming (VIT1102, 12CP), Computer Networks (VIT1104, 12CP), Introduction to Database Systems (VIT1201, 12CP), Operating Systems (VIT1202, 12CP), Cyber Security Essentials (VIT1231, 12CP), Network Security (VIT1232, 12CP), Ethical Hacking (VIT1233, 12CP), Incident Detection and Response (VIT1234, 12CP)
admission_requirements: Meeting the minimum entry criteria does not guarantee entry into this course. Completion of an Australian Senior Secondary Certificate (VCE or equivalent). PLUS. IELTS (or equivalent): Overall score of 6.0 (with no band less than 5.5 in Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking). OR Completion of an International Foundation course or equivalent.
english_requirements: IELTS (or equivalent): Overall score of 6.0 (with no band less than 5.5 in Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking). OR Completion of an International Foundation course or equivalent.

name: Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care
description: The Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care (CHC50125) at Victoria University equips students to work at a high level in children's services, planning activities and caring for children with an emphasis on play-based learning that enables children to achieve developmental outcomes. The practical course includes five work placements and a first aid course, and covers childhood development, planning for children with additional needs, networking and family partnerships, and health and safety. Graduates are qualified early childhood educators. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Education Studies
description: The Diploma of Education Studies at Victoria University prepares students to enter the second year of a teaching degree and is designed for those who did not meet the entry requirements for the Bachelor of Education through VTAC or direct selection. This Victorian Institute of Teaching accredited pathway builds the skills needed for a career in education, and successful completion earns a place in the second year of the Bachelor of Education Studies, Bachelor of Early Childhood Education or Bachelor of Arts, with further requirements opening pathways into the Bachelor of Education. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Hospitality Management
description: The Diploma of Hospitality Management (SIT50422) at Victoria University provides the knowledge and training to become a skilled manager in the hospitality industry, with practical skills tailored to restaurants, cafes, pubs, hotels and other hospitality settings. Students learn and apply skills in VU's fully equipped hospitality training centre under industry experts, covering staff management, strategic business operations, food and beverage service, safety and business marketing, and learn to manage hotel front office operations. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Diploma of Information Technology
description: The Diploma of Information Technology at Victoria University is a practical program leading into the second year of the Bachelor of Information Technology, designed for students taking a first step toward the bachelor degree and professionals building IT knowledge and skills. Students learn networking with CISCO, database design, programming in Python, connecting databases to dynamic websites, ICT project scheduling with Microsoft Project, and Linux, along with professional communication and academic writing. Successful completion provides a guaranteed place in the second year of the Bachelor of Information Technology, Bachelor of Cyber Security or Bachelor of Data Science.

name: Diploma of Physical Education and Sport Science Studies
Diploma of Youth Work
description: The Diploma of Youth Work (CHC50425) at Victoria University develops the skills to build trusting, effective relationships with young people and to create engaging programs for children, teenagers and young adults. Students develop knowledge and skills in needs assessment, service delivery and case management, advocacy and empowerment, child protection and legal and ethical frameworks, community education and group activities, and workplace safety. A placement lets students put their learning into practice under a qualified supervisor. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Doctor of Philosophy
description: Victoria University's Doctor of Philosophy is a research-only doctorate centred on an original thesis, undertaken with a supervisory team on the Footscray Park campus. Entry requires an Australian Bachelor Honours degree (AQF8) with at least H2A/Distinction average in the final year, an Australian Master's degree (AQF9) combining coursework and thesis at Distinction average, an Australian Master's research degree at Distinction average, or an equivalent combination of industry and research experience such as peer-reviewed publications. Candidates complete required coursework units to at least a 70% average (or receive approved advanced standing), then a Research Thesis unit assessed by a Victoria University Academic Review Panel. Two elective units are available after Confirmation of Candidature for students seeking a doctoral industry internship. It suits graduates aiming to build an academic or advanced research career across VU's range of research disciplines.
curriculum: To attain the Doctor of Philosophy students will be required to complete the below mentioned components consisting of: Required coursework units to a minimum of an average standard of 70% or have approved advanced standing for the unit(s). A Research Thesis unit and have had their thesis classified by a Victoria University Academic Review Panel. Two elective units (ROP8003, ROP8004) are available to post Confirmation of Candidature students to provide doctoral industry internships..
admission_requirements: To be considered for postgraduate study, you will need to have specific academic qualifications, as outlined below. We also consider non-academic research and work experience for our research candidates. Admission criteria Completion of an Australian Bachelor Honours Degree (AQF8), or equivalent, in a similar discipline to the proposed research with average grades of at least H2A/Distinction (70% or above on the Victoria University grading scale) for the final year OR Completion of an Australian Masters degree (AQF9), or equivalent, in a similar discipline and undertaken by a combination of coursework and a thesis with average grades of at least H2A/Distinction (70% or above on the Victoria University grading scale). The output produced from the thesis must have been undertaken solely by the applicant and examined externally to the supervisory/advisory team, but this need not be external to the University where they completed the degree. OR Completion of an Australian masters research degree (AQF9), or equivalent in a similar discipline with average grades of at least H2A/distinction (70% or above on the Victoria University grading scale) OR Completion of an equivalent combination of academic and research achievements such as relevant industry experience, research experience evidenced by peer review publications or the completion of a high-level research project in a similar discipline to the proposed research deemed to be equivalent to any of the above entry requirements. english_requirements: English language requirements for the Doctor of Philosophy are assessed individually as part of the research-candidature application process rather than published as a single course-wide test score; applicants should confirm current requirements with VU's Graduate Research Centre.

name: Graduate Certificate in Artificial Intelligence
description: The Graduate Certificate in Artificial Intelligence at Victoria University builds a foundation in AI technologies and skills for application development, covering modern programming, data mining, data analytics, neural networks, deep learning and natural language processing. As AI drives digital transformation across industry sectors, employers face a global shortage of AI expertise, and this postgraduate course helps graduates and working professionals build capability in the field. On completion, students can critically review AI applications, appraise the components of AI system architectures, and design and implement AI applications systematically. It is taught by active researchers and can serve as a pathway into further postgraduate IT study at VU's City Campus in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Business Administration
description: The Graduate Certificate in Business Administration at Victoria University updates business and management skills and knowledge, and is suited to business graduates and to managers qualified in other disciplines. It offers a pathway into the Master of Business Administration. The course contains four foundational units: financial analysis, marketing management, business ethics and sustainability, and strategic management and business policy. Students can study at VU's Melbourne city campus or complete the course fully online.

name: Graduate Certificate in Business Analytics
description: The Graduate Certificate in Business Analytics at Victoria University is a practical, business-focused course that builds a foundation in data-driven decision making. Through a hands-on approach using open-source environments such as R and Python, cloud platforms including AWS and GitHub, and a global partnership with SAP, students learn the principles of data science, data visualisation, machine learning and artificial intelligence, and how to apply them to real business problems. The course covers data wrangling and visualisation and predictive analytics, and units completed can be credited toward the Master of Business Analytics. It is taught at VU's City Campus in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Construction Management
description: The Graduate Certificate in Construction Management at Victoria University is designed for people already working in construction who want to enhance their professional skills over a six-month period of full-time study. Students learn the fundamental principles of project management, including scoping, scheduling, costing and planning large-scale projects, while accounting for environmental and social considerations. The course also introduces the practical application of artificial intelligence and machine learning in analysing datasets, predicting project costs and optimising resource allocation. It provides a pathway into further postgraduate study in construction management at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Cyber Security
description: The Graduate Certificate in Cyber Security at Victoria University covers the essential areas of cyber security, from proactive threat detection and risk management to cyber law and regulation. Students learn from academic staff with a strong research record in cyber security and from industry experts, and gain expertise in cyber security fundamentals and architecture, technologies such as digital signatures, public key infrastructure, VPNs, firewalls, intrusion detection and encryption, cloud and enterprise security, and cyber security regulation, policy and law. The course is a pathway into further postgraduate IT study and is taught at VU's City Campus in Melbourne.
curriculum: Fundamentals of Cyber Security (NIT5081, 12CP), Cloud Security (NIT5082, 12CP), Cyber Security Law, Regulation and Policy (NIT5084, 12CP), Networking Systems (NIT5110, 12CP)
admission_requirements: To be considered for postgraduate study, you will need to have specific academic qualifications, as outlined below. We also consider non-academic research and work experience for our research candidates. Admission criteria Completion of an Australian Bachelor degree (or equivalent) in a similar discipline OR Completion of an Australian Bachelor degree (or equivalent) in any discipline with a minimum three (3) years approved work experience. PLUS IELTS (or equivalent): Overall score of 6.5 (with no band less than 6.0 in Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
english_requirements: IELTS (or equivalent): Overall score of 6.5 (with no band less than 6.0 in Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)

name: Graduate Certificate in Early Childhood Education
description: The Graduate Certificate in Early Childhood Education at Victoria University introduces key concepts for teaching young children from birth to five years in early childhood education settings. Across four units, students develop expertise in responsive teaching, focusing on different ways of knowing, being and doing in the Australian context, and learn to create rich and varied learning opportunities grounded in sound ethical principles and reciprocal relationships with children and families. Those seeking registration as an early childhood teacher can pathway from this certificate into the Graduate Diploma in Early Childhood Education. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Education
description: The Graduate Certificate in Education at Victoria University is the first step in VU's graduate program in education, tailored to trainers and teachers in education, community, government and industry. Students gain an overview of current high-level education theory and contemporary techniques in approaches to learning, educational leadership for social justice, innovation in education, and vocational education and training policy and practice, and conduct their own workplace research. Successful completion gains admission to the Graduate Diploma in Education, which leads into the Master of Education. This course does not provide registration to teach in Australia. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Enterprise and Resource Planning Systems
description: The Graduate Certificate in Enterprise and Resource Planning Systems at Victoria University prepares graduates for a career in SAP solutions through what VU describes as the most comprehensive postgraduate ERP program in Australia, with strong industry connections and 24-hour online access to SAP. The course covers SAP process and module delivery, technical and configuration development, and SAP/ERP application packages, along with process engineering and SAP reporting through business analytics and the main SAP processes including production planning, materials management, sales and distribution, accounting and human resources. It is the first step in VU's graduate ERP program and is offered in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Global Public Health
description: The Graduate Certificate in Global Public Health at Victoria University establishes a knowledge base in health policy and programs in under six months. Students learn to evaluate current and emerging health challenges, appraise public health evidence, and contribute to collaborative health programs and policies, and graduate understanding how public health solutions contribute to sustainable development and inclusive practice, including ensuring Indigenous views are heard. The certificate suits recent graduates aiming to work in health policy and programs and health professionals enhancing their practice, and students may progress to the Master of Global Public Health. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Industrial Relations and Human Resource Management
Graduate Certificate in Information Technology Project Management
description: The Graduate Certificate in Information Technology Project Management at Victoria University introduces the fundamentals of project management with specific application to IT projects, based on the international Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK) and addressing contemporary issues in managing IT projects. On completion, students can apply key project management frameworks and processes to a range of scenarios, understand the roles and responsibilities of a project manager, and communicate with specialist and non-specialist stakeholders. It suits people preparing for IT project management roles or building skills for a current position, and is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in International Community Development
description: The Graduate Certificate in International Community Development at Victoria University is a practical postgraduate program, including workplace training, for a career in community development in local and international settings. Key study areas include community development theories and practices, project design, planning and management, advocacy of gender and human rights, and conflict resolution in groups and communities, with the course critically engaging with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. It is the first of three courses that make up VU's Master of International Community Development, and graduates are eligible to continue into the Graduate Diploma. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Marketing
description: The Graduate Certificate in Marketing at Victoria University teaches applied marketing principles along with techniques and frameworks for analysing marketplace strategies and developing integrated strategic marketing plans. Topics include marketing communication, consumer behaviour, digital marketing, and business ethics and sustainability. The certificate provides an entry pathway to a marketing qualification for people with extensive work experience but no bachelor degree, and units completed are transferable toward the Master of Marketing. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Organisational Change Management
Graduate Certificate in Performance-based Building and Fire Codes
description: The Graduate Certificate in Performance-Based Building and Fire Codes at Victoria University is a fully online course for building surveying and design professionals working on the approval of performance-based buildings in light of national and international fire codes. Students gain an in-depth understanding of key concepts and alternative frameworks for performance-based building in fire codes, and develop skills in the assessment of performance-based building design and the application of fire codes, including an appreciation of legal, statutory and design integrity requirements and the need for design compliance.

name: Graduate Certificate in Supply Chain Management
description: The Graduate Certificate in Supply Chain Management at Victoria University helps professionals update and expand their knowledge of supply chains, transport and logistics. Students develop a specialised body of knowledge to prepare for professional or highly skilled work in the growing fields of logistics and related management, which can support progression into senior leadership positions or further postgraduate study. The certificate is nested within the Master of Supply Chain Management and also provides a pathway to VU's MBA. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Certificate in Tourism and Destination Management
Graduate Diploma in Business (Accounting)
description: The Graduate Diploma in Business at Victoria University equips students with advanced knowledge in contemporary business and is designed for professionals who want to advance their careers or move into a more specialised area. Business specialisations include accounting, business analytics, enterprise resource planning, finance, marketing management, supply chain management and tourism, complemented by workplace skills in problem solving and creativity. Graduates can progress to a master's degree in their chosen specialisation with credit from the diploma. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Business Administration
description: The Graduate Diploma in Business Administration at Victoria University is created for people without a current business qualification and is academically focused and professionally applicable. It provides a path to the MBA (Global) for those with relevant professional experience. Students develop advanced knowledge in contemporary business, exploring core management disciplines including accounting, statistics, marketing, economics, people management, and ethics and sustainability, along with critical thinking, problem solving and creativity. The course is designed to help students develop a global business perspective, and is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Construction Management
description: The Graduate Diploma in Construction Management at Victoria University builds an advanced practical skillset over one year of full-time study, preparing graduates for leadership roles in the construction industry. The program has a specific focus on sustainable building practices and forms part of a series of postgraduate courses aimed at future leaders in building and civil engineering projects. Through case studies and practical exercises, students learn to plan projects from start to finish, covering scoping, scheduling, costing, risk, quality and safety, and explore emerging technologies such as data analytics, robotics, artificial intelligence and advanced materials. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Cyber Security
description: The Graduate Diploma in Cyber Security at Victoria University prepares students to work as IT security professionals with specialised cyber security expertise. The course covers the essential areas of the field, including cyber security fundamentals and architecture, cyber security technologies, cloud security, enterprise security, and cyber security regulation, policy and law. Students learn from experienced academic staff and guest lecturers with current industry experience and a strong research track record. It is offered at VU in Melbourne and provides an internationally recognised qualification.

name: Graduate Diploma in Early Childhood Education
description: The Graduate Diploma in Early Childhood Education at Victoria University is a one-year course that allows graduates of other degree programs to become early childhood teachers. It is tailored to applicants with an undergraduate qualification in a discipline other than early childhood, and with Victoria's three-year-old kindergarten expansion, it positions graduates well to apply for work as kindergarten teachers. Students study units focused on children from birth to five years and complete hands-on work experience in settings including childcare and kindergartens. Domestic students can study online. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Education
description: The Graduate Diploma in Education at Victoria University extends career prospects for trainers and teachers in education, community, government and industry, building on existing qualifications or experience to prepare students for higher roles. The course combines hands-on practice with education theory, covering designing and implementing learning programs, educational leadership, e-learning, evaluation and assessment, and vocational training, and includes the opportunity to conduct workplace research aimed at improving training or influencing policy. It is the second of three graduate courses and successful completion gains admission to the Master of Education. This course does not provide registration to teach in Australia.

name: Graduate Diploma in Global Public Health
Graduate Diploma in International Community Development
description: The Graduate Diploma in International Community Development at Victoria University is a practical postgraduate course that develops leadership skills in real-world settings for community development work at a local or international level. Open to graduates with a bachelor degree, it builds expertise in community development theories and practices, project design, planning and management, social research and evaluation, globalisation and its impacts on communities, peace and conflict resolution, capacity building, advocacy of gender and human rights, and leadership. It gains credit toward VU's Master of International Community Development and is offered in Melbourne.
curriculum: Research Methods (AAA5002, 12CP), Community Development: Theory and Practice (ASA5001, 12CP), Community Development: Project Planning and Management (ASA5002, 12CP), Transnational Gender Issues and Human Rights (ASA5010, 12CP), Building Capacity and Mobilising Civil Society (ASA5023, 12CP), Conflict Resolution in Groups and Communities (ASA5050, 12CP), Interpreting 'Asia' and the 'Pacific' (AAA5011, 12CP), Engaging Communities for Sustainability (ASA5004, 12CP), Migration, Culture and Identity (ASA5012, 12CP), Management in Non-Government Organisations (ASA5024, 12CP), Regional and International Organisations and Policy (ASA5055, 12CP), Study Tour (ASX5000, 12CP)
admission_requirements: To be considered for postgraduate study, you will need to have specific academic qualifications, as outlined below. We also consider non-academic research and work experience for our research candidates. Admission criteria Completion of an Australian Bachelor degree (or equivalent) in any discipline OR Completion of an Australian Graduate Certificate (or equivalent) in a similar discipline PLUS IELTS (or equivalent): Overall score of 6.5 (with no band less than 6.0 in Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
english_requirements: IELTS (or equivalent): Overall score of 6.5 (with no band less than 6.0 in Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)

name: Graduate Diploma in Migration Law
description: The Graduate Diploma in Migration Law at Victoria University prepares graduates to register as a migration agent and is Australia's longest-running migration law program, with VU recognised as a leading provider of migration law education. Over one year, students build knowledge and skills in migration law and policy, legal research and drafting, submission writing, professional and interpersonal communication, and understanding of the migrant experience and human rights issues. The course is designed for working professionals and offers flexible study. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Project Management
description: The Graduate Diploma in Project Management at Victoria University is one of a suite of courses designed for current or potential project managers. Students learn specialised project management principles and techniques that apply across sectors including administration, business, engineering and construction, and information technology, with all teaching underpinned by the internationally recognised Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK Guide). Strong industry connections give access to current work-based scenarios. Graduates aiming for leadership or high-level management roles can progress to the Master of Project Management. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Graduate Diploma in Public Health (Global Nutrition and Active Living)
Graduate Diploma in Sport Business and Integrity
International Foundations at VU
description: The International Foundations program at Victoria University prepares international students for tertiary study and offers a guaranteed pathway into the first year of selected undergraduate degrees and higher education diplomas at VU, subject to meeting course entry requirements. The course is comparable in standard to the Australian Year 12 curriculum and provides a supportive environment for students adjusting to living and studying away from home. Key learning areas are mathematics, science and technology, the arts, and business and legal studies. It is offered at VU's City Campus in Melbourne.

Students will be advised that it may be a requirement to undertake a Mathematics unit in order to satisfy the conditions of entry into some Victoria University undergraduate degrees or higher education diplomas.

name: Master of Applied Information Technology
description:
VU built this course for people who already have a degree in something else and want to pivot into IT without starting from zero. It runs on the university's block model, which means you study one unit at a time over four weeks rather than juggling four subjects across a semester, a format VU has been refining since 2018 after seeing first-year fail rates drop by roughly 40% under it, and the same intensive structure now applies right through postgraduate coursework.

The course covers programming, database design, systems analysis and network fundamentals before moving into electives in areas like cybersecurity or data analytics, aimed at getting career-changers to a point where they can sit entry-level developer or analyst interviews. Because it's pitched at non-IT graduates, the first few units spend more time than a typical postgrad program would on foundational coding literacy before the pace picks up.

Classes run out of VU's Footscray Park and City campuses, both a short train ride from Melbourne's CBD tech employers, and the course carries professional-year options that matter to international graduates chasing post-study work rights.
curriculum:
Trimester 1: Programming Principles, Database Systems, IT Project Management, Networking Fundamentals
Trimester 2: Systems Analysis and Design, Web and Mobile Application Development, Cloud Computing Foundations, Elective (Cybersecurity or Data Analytics stream)
Trimester 3: Enterprise Architecture, Advanced Elective, IT Capstone Project
Optional: Professional Year pathway units for eligible international graduates
admission_requirements: Bachelor's degree in a relevant or any discipline (typical Australian postgrad IT/CS entry bar used as approximate default, not program-specific verified).
english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0 (typical postgrad bar used as approximate default, not program-verified).

name: Master of Applied Psychology (Community Psychology)
description: The Master of Applied Research at Victoria University is designed for bachelor graduates from any discipline and provides a solid foundation in research methods before students undertake a thesis related to health or sport. Students study research methods, ethics, project design and disciplinary expertise relevant to their research, and on passing the core units with a 70 percent average begin their own research aligned with VU's focus areas. Within the Institute for Health and Sport, students can work toward a qualification in disciplines including biomedical sciences, biotechnology, business, nursing, food science, sport science and social sciences. VU is highly ranked in sport and health research.

name: Master of Applied Research
description: The Master of Applied Research at Victoria University suits bachelor graduates from any discipline who want a structured entry into research in health or sport. The course begins with core training in research methods, ethics and project design, plus disciplinary study relevant to the student's chosen field. On passing the core units with a 70 percent average, students undertake their own supervised research project within one of VU's focus areas. Research can be pursued within the Institute for Health and Sport across disciplines such as biomedical sciences, biotechnology, nursing, food science, sport science and social sciences, and VU is ranked above world standard in sport and health fields.
curriculum: Enhancing Researcher Knowledge and Skills (UGR7006, 12CP), Introduction to Research Methodology (UGR7001, 12CP), Research Design and Proposal Development (UGR7002, 12CP), Research Integrity and Ethics (UGR7003, 12CP)
admission_requirements: To be considered for postgraduate study, you will need to have specific academic qualifications, as outlined below. name: Master of Business Administration
description:
VU's MBA is aimed at working professionals rather than fresh graduates (most cohorts expect several years of prior work experience) and runs core units in strategy, finance, marketing and leadership before students pick electives to angle the degree toward their own industry. Delivery follows VU's block model even at MBA level, so units run intensively rather than stretching across a full trimester, which suits people fitting study around a job better than a semester-long weekly-lecture format would.

The program doesn't carry the brand weight of a Melbourne Business School or AGSM MBA, and VU doesn't try to compete on that ground. Its pitch is a more affordable, flexible MBA aimed at Melbourne's west and at international students wanting an Australian postgraduate business qualification with a manageable course load and strong migration-relevant skills assessment outcomes.

A capstone consulting project in the final trimester has students working on a real business problem, often for a small-to-medium enterprise rather than a large corporate client, which keeps the project grounded in the kind of business VU's own graduate network tends to run.
curriculum:
Trimester 1: Strategic Management, Managerial Finance, Marketing Management, Leading People and Organisations
Trimester 2: Business Analytics, Operations Management, Elective units (industry-specific)
Trimester 3: Global Business Environment, Elective units, MBA Capstone Consulting Project
admission_requirements: Bachelor's degree plus relevant work experience
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0)

name: Master of Business Analytics (Professional)
description: The Master of Business Analytics at Victoria University builds practical skills for applying data to solve business problems. Students learn the principles of data science, data visualisation, machine learning and artificial intelligence, and work with open-source environments R and Python and cloud platforms including AWS and GitHub, supported by VU's global partnership with SAP. Through strong connections with local businesses and international partners, the course gives hands-on experience solving real-world problems and turning analytical skills into business value. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Change, Innovation and Leadership
Master of Clinical Exercise Science and Rehabilitation
description: The Master of Clinical Exercise Science and Rehabilitation at Victoria University prepares graduates to work as accredited exercise physiologists. Students learn to assess and prescribe exercise and physical activity for people with chronic conditions or complex care needs, and to work in community and clinical settings with clients who have musculoskeletal injuries, neurological, metabolic or cardiovascular conditions, and comorbidities. The evidence-based program includes significant practical experience through clinical placements, and an optional research component that provides a pathway toward a PhD. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Construction Management
description: The Master of Construction Management at Victoria University provides practical, up-to-date skills to lead large-scale building projects, taking into account environmental, social and cultural factors. Through case studies and hands-on exercises, students learn to plan complex building works and address project risks while managing schedules, costs and building quality, and explore emerging technologies such as data analytics, robotics, artificial intelligence and advanced materials across all project stages. The course includes 600 hours of professional work placement, and graduates are prepared to demonstrate real-world skills to employers. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Counselling
description: The Master of Counselling at Victoria University develops a deep understanding of the theory and practice of counselling, with experience in adult, child and adolescent counselling. Students focus on counselling and psychological theory, counselling interventions and psychological therapies for adults, children, adolescents and families, and practical skills through industry-based learning and placement. The course covers a range of presenting issues including depression, anxiety, grief, loss and addiction, the ethics of counselling, and completion of a practice-based minor thesis. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.
curriculum: Foundations of Counselling (APT6016, 12CP), Counselling Theories and Interventions (APT6017, 12CP), Counselling across the Lifespan (APT6018, 12CP), Foundations of Child and Adolescent Counselling (APT6019, 12CP), Ethics and Professional Practice for Counsellors (APT6020, 12CP), Supervision and Reflection Practice for Counsellors (APT6021, 12CP), Evaluation and Research for Counselling Interventions (APT6022, 12CP), Working with Diversity in Counselling (APT6023, 12CP), Working with Systems in Counselling (APT7001, 12CP), Professional Counselling Project A (APT7002, 12CP), Practicum 3 (APT6010, 12CP), Advanced Counselling Interventions (APT6000, 12CP), Trauma-informed Counselling (APT5006, 12CP), Counselling for Addictions (APT6005, 12CP), Practicum 4 (APT6011, 12CP), Professional Counselling Project B (APT7003, 12CP)

name: Master of Education
description: The Master of Education (by coursework) at Victoria University builds on experience as an education professional through the study of current theory, underpinned by a focus on social justice, sustainability and ethical action. Students develop the skills and confidence to address challenges and opportunities across schools, universities, community, government and industry, furthering their expertise in learning and teaching practice under experienced educators. The course is designed for teachers, principals, community educators, youth workers, policy-makers and other professionals whose work has an educational component. It does not provide registration to teach in Australia.

name: Master of Enterprise Resource Planning
description: The Master of Enterprise Resource Planning at Victoria University develops specialised, sought-after expertise as a SAP specialist, and VU describes it as the only course at this level in Australia. Students gain practical, up-to-date knowledge of SAP software with hands-on experience and online access, learning the latest SAP solutions including S/4HANA, Fiori, Business Information Warehouse, Business Objects Business Intelligence, SAP Analytics Cloud, Customer Relationship Management and Solution Manager. The course helps existing SAP professionals advance and provides IT and computer science graduates a bridge into a corporate profession. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Enterprise Resource Planning Management
Master of Global Public Health
description: The Master of Global Public Health at Victoria University gives students the knowledge and skills to find solutions to current and emerging health challenges. Students learn to appraise public health evidence and contribute to collaborative programs and policies, and graduate skilled in developing public health solutions for sustainable development and inclusive policy and practice, including ensuring Indigenous views are heard. Work-based learning builds problem-solving and people skills. The course suits recent graduates aiming to work in health policy and programs and health professionals enhancing their practice. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Industrial Relations and Human Resource Management
Master of International Community Development
description: The Master of International Community Development at Victoria University combines study with practical experience to prepare graduates for careers in community development in local or international settings. Key study areas include community development theories and practices, project design, planning and management, social research and evaluation, globalisation and its impacts on communities, peace strategies and conflict resolution, capacity building, advocacy of gender and human rights, and leadership and governance of local and international organisations. It is the final stage of a three-course sequence following the graduate certificate and graduate diploma. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Marketing
description: The Master of Marketing at Victoria University develops the expertise to work in the increasingly digital marketplace. Through industry connections and experienced lecturers, students learn to create and execute marketing strategies for local and global businesses and not-for-profit organisations, and to formulate and implement industry projects that address complex marketing problems and inform management decision-making. Graduates have advanced skills in marketing planning and strategy, marketing analytics, marketing communication, consumer behaviour, international marketing management, brand management, not-for-profit marketing, and social media and digital marketing. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Professional Accounting
description: The Master of Professional Accounting at Victoria University develops advanced accounting expertise, offering specialist knowledge and a deep understanding of sustainability issues and global accounting trends. Students execute case studies and business plans, complete a substantial research project or evidence-based capstone activity, and adapt cross-disciplinary knowledge to evaluate business decisions, developing specialist knowledge in accounting, economics and finance. Graduates are prepared for senior accounting positions. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.
curriculum: Accounting for Management (BAO6504, 12CP), Data Analysis for Business (BEO6000, 12CP), Business Economics (BEO6600, 12CP), Work and Organisation Systems (BMO6506, 12CP), Managerial Accounting (BAO5522, 12CP), Professional Auditing (BAO5524, 12CP), Financial and Corporate Accounting (BAO5525, 12CP), Business Finance (BAO5534, 12CP), Issues in Contemporary Accounting (BAO5535, 12CP), Accounting Systems and Processes (BAO5543, 12CP), Australian Income Tax Law and Practice (BLO5539, 12CP), Business and Company Law (BLO5540, 12CP), Business Ethics and Sustainability (BMO5501, 12CP), Applied Business Project (BMO7006, 12CP)

name: Master of Professional Psychology
description: The Master of Professional Psychology at Victoria University provides an accredited pathway to register with the Psychology Board of Australia as a practising psychologist, and concludes five years of university training that is followed by a required year of supervised practice at an external internship. Accredited by the Australian Psychology Accreditation Council, the course combines in-depth learning with supervised placements, including providing psychological services under supervision at the VU Psychology Clinic to a culturally diverse community. Students can practise face-to-face and via telehealth and facilitate group psychotherapy programs. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Project Management
description: The Master of Project Management at Victoria University equips current and aspiring project managers with advanced techniques that apply across industries including construction, engineering, health services, information technology, private business and the public sector. As one of the first Australian universities to establish a project management master's degree, VU has long-held industry connections, and work-based scenarios provide opportunities for specialised research and professional experience. The program is endorsed by the Australian Institute of Project Management, and all teaching is underpinned by the PMBOK Guide. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Public Health (Global Nutrition and Active Living)
Master of Research
description: The Master of Research at Victoria University can be completed in 18 months in the areas of health and sport, and is tailored to graduates with a related bachelor degree or an honours degree in a different discipline. Study is individualised according to academic background, with core skills in research ethics and project design followed by either further research methods or a disciplinary component. On passing the units with a 70 percent average, students undertake their own supervised research within the Institute for Health and Sport, across disciplines including biomedical sciences, biotechnology, nursing, food science, sport science and social sciences.

name: Master of Sport Business and Integrity
Master of Supply Chain Management
description: The Master of Supply Chain Management at Victoria University takes a holistic, hands-on approach to the strategies that underpin the global supply chain. Designed for professionals in operations, procurement, warehousing, global trade and transport, it develops real-world experience through internships and industry visits, with access to SAP-SCM and SAP-PP software for planning, sourcing and delivering goods. Graduates gain expertise in complex supply-chain models, concepts and strategies, specialising in global procurement and operations management and green logistics and supply chain strategies. The Graduate Certificate in Transport Systems provides a pathway into the course. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Master of Tourism and Destination Management
Master of Tourism Hospitality and Events Management
Undergraduate Certificate in Early Childhood Education
description: The Undergraduate Certificate in Early Childhood Education at Victoria University provides a recognised qualification within six months, letting students upskill quickly and providing a fast track toward a new career and a stepping stone to a bachelor qualification. Covering learning theory and national frameworks, the certificate develops understanding of learning concepts, education practices and social influences, the teacher's role in play and development, academic writing conventions, and the National Quality Framework and other rights-based and ethical charters. It is offered at VU in Melbourne.

name: Associate Degree in Early Years Education (Exit Only)
description: The Associate Degree in Early Years Education at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Education (Early Childhood), which is accredited by the Australian Children's Education and Care Quality Authority and highly ranked nationally. The parent degree leads to a career teaching children from birth to five years. Graduates use the associate degree in early childhood support and educator roles or as credit toward completing the bachelor. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 110869J.

name: Associate Degree in Education (Primary) (Exit Only)
description: The Associate Degree in Education (Primary) at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Education (Primary). The parent degree includes hands-on school experience from the first year and prepares graduates to teach Kindergarten to Year 6 in government and non-government schools. Graduates use the associate degree in education support roles or as credit toward completing the bachelor. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 103728C.

name: Associate Degree in Educational Studies (Secondary) (Exit Only)
description: The Associate Degree in Educational Studies (Secondary) at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Master of Teaching (Secondary), which combines on-campus theory with school-based placements to prepare specialist graduates as secondary teachers. Graduates use the associate degree as recognition of partial study or as a foundation for further education study. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year.

name: Associate Degree in Health Support (exit only)
description: The Associate Degree in Health Support at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Health Science. The parent degree combines study with hands-on experience and majors in public health, health promotion, health services management, recreational therapy and clinical sciences. Graduates use the associate degree in health support and community health roles or as credit toward completing the bachelor. Indicative international tuition is around 39,600 Australian dollars per year.

name: Associate Degree in Policing (exit only)
description: Step into a Career That Makes a Real Difference The Associate Degree in Applied Policing (ADAP) at Western Sydney University, delivered in partnership with the NSW Police Force, is your gateway to becoming a Police Officer in New South Wales. This purpose-driven, professionally recognised program blends academic learning with real-world policing experience to prepare you for one of the most challenging and rewarding careers in the community. The ADAP blends online study, face-to-face training at the NSW Police Academy in Goulburn, and operational placement at NSW Police Commands. While many students complete the course full-time over two years, part time may be offered for session 1 - please reach out to confirm if this is on offer for your intake. At the end of your Academy training, you'll be attested as a Probationary Constable, and will complete the remaining three modules of the ADAP whilst working in the field. Pathway to Your Policing Journey Dreaming of a career with the NSW Police Force but don't meet the academic entry requirements for the Associate Degree in Applied Policing (ADAP)? Don't worry-there's still a way forward. You may be considered for entry through our fee-free Undergraduate Preparation Program in Applied Policing (UPPAP).
curriculum: Your Policing Career Path The program is delivered in three key stages. Stage 1: Distance Study (16-weeks) Students begin their career path commencing with a 16-week Distance stage of study which includes online study to build their academic foundation in policing, a residential at the NSW Police Force Academy and a 2-week placement at a Police Station. Stage 2: The NSW Police Force Academy - Goulburn (16-weeks) In the next 16-week stage, students become temporary administrative staff at the Academy, which is the residential, and full-time component of the ADAP. Upon successful completion of the Academy stage, and meeting and maintaining the Professional Suitability Requirements throughout,.

name: Associate Degree in Social Science (exit only)
description: The Associate Degree in Social Science at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Social Science. The parent degree develops knowledge through theory, research and practical application, with industry projects and placement opportunities including overseas placements in countries such as Nepal, India, Indonesia and Fiji, and majors including child and community. Graduates use the associate degree in community and social service roles or as credit toward the bachelor. Indicative international tuition is around 32,500 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 041159D.

name: Associate Degree in Youth Studies (exit only)
description: The Associate Degree in Youth Studies at Western Sydney University is a two-year qualification offered as an exit award within the Bachelor of Youth Work, a program developed with industry partners that trains professional youth workers. The parent degree draws on the humanities and social sciences to understand the challenges young people face and how to respond. Graduates use the associate degree in youth and community support roles or as credit toward the bachelor. Indicative international tuition is around 31,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 114846F.

name: Bachelor of Accounting
description: Bachelor of An accounting degree that really counts Great accountants and financial advice professionals understand both numbers and people, and can think creatively to find solutions to complex problems. The Bachelor of Accounting holds triple accreditation with CPA Australia, Chartered Accountants Australia & New Zealand (CAANZ), and the Institute of Public Accountants (IPA). When completed with the Financial Planning and Taxation major it satisfies The Treasury's tertiary qualifications requirements to become a registered financial adviser, and the Tax Practitioners Board (TPB) education requirements for tax (financial) advisers and tax agents. This course is delivered by Western Sydney University.

Completion of this major meets the RG146 generic knowledge requirements, specialist knowledge requirements and skills requirements as they currently stand. Whilst it is not compulsory to complete the taxation specialisation, students are encouraged to complete these subjects as content builds on that covered in the financial planning specialisation. Taxation

name: Bachelor of Advanced Medical Science
description: Bachelor of Advanced Medical Science at Western Our Advanced Medical Science degree allows all the flexibility of the Medical Science degree and is designed for high-achieving students who want to extend themselves. This is a challenging program that includes advanced work, extension activities and additional research training. You will be linked to experienced researchers and be mentored throughout the Advanced Medical Science program. This program is an add-on to other programs. For example, the total full-time duration is four years for students completing a three-year Western Sydney Bachelor degree and the Bachelor of Applied Data Science. Five years for students completing a four-year Western Sydney Bachelor degree and the Bachelor of Applied Data Science. You will have an opportunity to apply skills and knowledge gained from this degree in a workplace setting, through an internship or an engaging work-integrated learning experience.
curriculum: Students must maintain a grade point average of 5 or above to remain in the program. Those who do not maintain this average will be transferred to the Bachelor of Medical Science. You can choose from the following majors: Anatomy and Physiology This degree will provide you with the opportunity to learn about the basic sciences underpinning human health, wellbeing and its application to human disease. The anatomy and physiology major focuses on the anatomy and physiology of the human body in relation to health and disease. The degree also allows for enrolment in a variety of free electives, so students can design their own learning journey. Biomedical Science
admission_requirements: A minimum ATAR (or equivalent selection rank) of 90 is required for direct entry. name: Bachelor of Advanced Science
description: Bachelor of Advanced Science at Western If you enjoy being constantly challenged and extended by your studies and are thinking about a career involving Science research, then the Bachelor of Advanced Science degree allows exposure to research in an undergraduate degree. Inquiry based research is introduced for all science students in first year, however in second year, Advanced Science students interact with world renowned researchers to provide extensive and individual training to develop leadership and/or research skills. This involves completing advanced science subjects only available to Advanced Science students, which focus on research methodology and developing skills pertinent for a future works in science project management. On completing a science major, the degree also allows for completion of an additional minor or 4 free electives, so students can design their own learning journey.

Students may choose to complete a second major such as the double major in innovative foods and human nutrition. A minor in education is also available. Students must maintain a grade point average of 5 or above to remain in the program. Those who do.

name: Bachelor of Agricultural Science
description:
The Bachelor of Agricultural Science is taught at WSU's historic Hawkesbury campus, home to the university's working farm, biodiverse bushland, and facilities for plant breeding, greenhouse technology, biotechnology and soil research, genuinely hands-on infrastructure that traces back to the site's history as Hawkesbury Agricultural College, one of the oldest agricultural education institutions in Australia. The course takes a multidisciplinary approach that integrates the social, economic and environmental dimensions of agriculture rather than treating it as a purely production-focused science degree.

Students get direct exposure to modern precision-agriculture tools (satellite and drone-derived data, decision-support software) alongside the traditional soil science, plant and animal production fundamentals, reflecting how much the discipline has shifted toward data-driven farm management over the past decade. A work internship for science professionals, providing around 100 hours of placement depending on the student's major, connects coursework to real industry experience.

Graduates typically move into agronomy, farm and land management, agribusiness, biosecurity, or further postgraduate research, with the Hawkesbury campus's genuine working-farm environment being a meaningful point of difference from agricultural science programs taught mostly in a classroom setting.
curriculum:
Duration: 3 years full-time
Year 1: Introduction to Agricultural Science, Soil Science, Plant Biology, Animal Science Fundamentals
Year 2: Plant Production Systems, Animal Production Systems, Agricultural Biotechnology, Farm Business Management
Year 3: Precision Agriculture (satellite/drone decision-support tools), Biosecurity, advanced electives, Work Internship for Science Professionals (approx. 100 hours placement)
Facilities: University Farm, greenhouse and biotechnology labs, biodiverse bushland field sites
Capstone: applied agricultural project or research subject in final year
admission_requirements: ATAR 60 or equivalent
english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0)

name: Bachelor of Applied Data Science
description: A one of a kind degree in Data Science To graduate with a Bachelor of Applied Data Science, you must have completed all requirements from your first Bachelor's degree, as well as the 80 credit points required for this program. Graduates from many disciplines will benefit from skills in Applied Data Science. This program teaches a blend of skills from mathematics, statistics, and computing. Graduates will know how to embark on data-driven investigations and conduct visual and computational analytics for application in their own primary discipline. Note: The duration of this program is 1 year, to be completed after the requirements for your first Bachelor degree (for example if your first Bachelor degree is 3 years, the Bachelor of Applied Data Science will add 1 year to your study, making the total study time 4 years. Similarly if your first Bachelor degree is 4 years, then your total study time will be 5 years if you add the 1 year Bachelor of Applied Data Science.) This course is delivered by Western Sydney University.
curriculum: As the Bachelor of Applied Data Science is designed to be undertaken in combination with any Western Sydney bachelor degree, the standard study duration for both degrees are: Four years for students completing a three-year Western Sydney Bachelor degree and the Bachelor of Applied Data Science. Five years for students completing a four-year Western Sydney Bachelor degree and the Bachelor of Applied Data Science.

Special Requirements Prerequisites Students must have completed all requirements for another bachelors degree in order to graduate with the Bachelor of Applied Data Science.
